Set in ancient China during the fall of a ruthless empire, bounty hunter Dao Ma breaks his code to protect a child and becomes the hunted. What begins as a routine escort mission turns into an epic fight for survival against assassins, warlords, and the forces of fate.



(Source: Kana)

title: Monster Pet Evolution
description:
The world suffered a change, and monsters began to appear. During this new era, a new profession is born. Tame the monsters, raise the monsters and train the monsters. They are the monster trainers. An innocent youth with a dream has been thrown into this golden age.
Gao Peng: Even if it’s just a lizard, I’ll make it evolve into a dragon that can soar into the sky!



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Soul Land 4: Ultimate Fighting
synonyms: Soul Land IV - The Ultimate Battle
Soul Land IV - The Ultimate Combat
description:
The Douluo federal expedition team found an egg with golden and silver patterns in the Northernmost Land. After detecting, they found signs of life inside. They quickly brought it back to their Institute for incubation. The egg hatched and a human baby came out; at the same time, the Federal Academy of Sciences was unfreezing a silver-haired woman, and a blue-haired young man was found on the waterfront.

(Source: Webnovel)

relations.title: Soul Land 3: Legend of the Dragon King
Soul Land 5: The Rebirth of Tang San
The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice: Season 1

title: I Have a Mansion in the Post-Apocalyptic World
synonyms: I have a suite in the last days
description:
Jiang Chen crossed into the judgment day after the nuclear war, and there was a mess everywhere. In order to survive, Jiang Chen led the refugees to establish a base area and set up a federation. Then carry the judgment day's technology and return to the true world. Change the political structure of the earth, rescue the world in a critical moment, and establish the Great Union of Earth Federation! Expanding the territory and fighting the threat from the sky.

(source: Webnovel)

title: Once Upon a time in Spirit Sword Mountain
description:
In order to find the child chosen by fate, the Spirit Sword Sect has decided to reopen its entrance exam to select talented disciples. Wang Lu, who possesses a rare Spiritual Root that is said to appear once in a millennium, will take on the challenging entrance exam and embark on his unique path of cultivation.



(Source: WebComics)

title: My Delicious Dream Boy
synonyms: Don't Get Eaten by the Dream Demon
Watch Out for the Dream Demon
君の悪夢美味しくいただきます
description:
Yi Kui's got everything you could dream of... good looks, charisma, and style. After all, he's secretly a demon on the hunt for the best dreams to feast upon. Yi Kui can't believe his luck when he stumbles upon the new student—shy, sweet Lin You, who also happens to dream the most delectable nightmares. He immediately tries to charm Lin You, but none of his spells are working! Now Yi Kui's gotta beguile him the old-fashioned way... What happens when the boy of your dreams is actually here to devour them?



(Source: Tapas, edited)

title: The Unstoppable
synonyms: 人生リセットで守護者に覚醒
description:
After his death, Duan Fei regressed 20 years back in time to those key hours before the virus catastrophe was set off. Now he'll have a chance to remedy the regret he has shouldered for those 20 long years.
He will utilize all the knowledge he brought back from his previous life to prepare for the oncoming apocalypse. His newly acquired ‘Evolutionary Tree” will help him continue to grow stronger. Duan Fei was just a survivor in his previous life, now he will be the hero and the savior of the world in this life.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

authors.name: Tuzi Zhuan Chi Wo Bian Cao

title: Return of the Heavenly Monarch
synonyms: Mortal Life of the Celestial Emperor
description:
He was away from home for 3 years... and away from his world for 3,000 years.



3 years ago, he fell into a rift, into a world of immortals, where time flew differently. He struggled 3,000 years there to come home, only to find his family... gone.
Now a 3,000-year-old monster, will he slaughter his way to the reunion, or... will he have to start all over again?



(Source: MangaToon)

title: Above Myriads
description:
I keep saying that I don't have any spiritual power, but they won't believe me! The random doorkeeper claims that I'm the greatest martial artist in the world, and they take his word for it! Wake up guys! I'm really not the martial god you're looking for!!



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: A Villainess No More
description:
All her life, Elizabeth has been eclipsed by her warmhearted younger sister, who cares for the common people and rejects the privileges of nobility. In contrast, Elizabeth is seen as an out-of-touch aristocrat who loves to throw lavish parties and frequent the royal palace. Although she works hard for the good of the kingdom, her contributions go largely unnoticed because of her unsavory reputation. One of the few people who are willing to give her a chance is the Archduke of Winternight, the “monster of the North.” As a misunderstood soul himself, he feels a special connection to her and opens up his home. And so, Elizabeth moves to the far North, away from the people she’s known her whole life... Will she finally be able to start over with a clean slate? Or will her past stand in the way of her future with the Archduke?



(Source: Tappytoon)



Chapter Count:

Season 1: Prologue + 99 chapters

Intermission: 10 chapters

Season 2: 82 chapters



Note: Based on a Korean novel by the Korean author Nunoiz, the webcomic is drawn by a Chinese artist and was first released in Chinese.

title: Jueshi Zhan Hun
description: In Jang Lin, the martial arts path cannot be walked for those who cannot awaken the martial spirit. In this world, only those who have a strong fighting spirit can communicate with the heavens and the earth. Born in Linshui, Chen Nan was an unparalleled genius with talent and thought he would become a great fighter in the future. However, Chen Nan was struck by lightning rays while practicing his martial arts and obtaining the spirit of divine battle, which was able to settle. To break the ultimate rule of Jang Lin, Qin Nan didn’t know that his fighting spirit possessed a great secret that would slowly discover mystery as the story continued.

title: Endgame Restart
description: A young man named Yang Fan was betrayed by his girlfriend while he and his sister at death's door, when suddenly, he traveled back to the past. Last time, you guys bullied me and sold me out. This time, with the power of the ring, only the strongest can survive. And I, am the strongest.

title: Don’t Say You Love Me
description:
I treated you like a brother, so how could you confess to me?! I only wanted to avoid you but I ended up hurting you through an accident. I’m sorry. If I had another chance, I definitely won't run away again. However… That chance came so fast. I suddenly traveled back three years ago and met you again. The you who doesn’t yet know me.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Originally serialized under the title "Bie Dui Wo Biaobai (别对我表白)".

title: Meizi Tai Duo, Zhihao Feisheng Le
titleRomaji: Meizi Tai Duo, Zhihao Feisheng Le
synonyms: My Harem Grew So Large, I Was Forced to Ascend
description:
Tsundere shaman, demonic master, yandere kouhai, barefoot alchemist, and the sword-saint in white silk. Ye Gulou, the young, handsome, and most powerful cultivator on the continent, is surrounded by five beautiful ladies, all of whom are out to kill him! The only way out is to attempt ascending to immortality, but he transmigrated to another world instead, along with his five pursuers! Now they are elf, beast-girl, lady knight, high-priestess, with more girls still to come! Caught between girls from two worlds, his thousand-year virgin-cultivation progress is in grave danger! Meanwhile, even more cute isekai girls are joining in~~



(Source: Bilibili, translated)



Note: Chapter count includes six bonus chapters.

title: Shen Yin Wangzuo
description: While the demons were rising, mankind was about to become extinct. Six temples rose, and protected the last of mankind. A young boy joins the temple as a knight to save his mother. During his journey of wonders and mischief in the world of temples and demons, will he be able to ascend to become the strongest knight and inherit the throne?

relations.title: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect

title: Salt Friend
description:
The delinquent Tong Yang was suspended after getting into a fight on the first day of school. Upon return, he was shunned by all his classmates. The top-scorer Xiao Zhen ran into Tong Yang hidden away crying by himself. Tong Yang tried to act tough, but his bluster only got him beat up instead. But for some reason, Xiao Zhen began to tutor Tong Yang after school, until Tong Yang found out that the boy who fought him that day was Xiao Zhen's little brother...



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)



Note: The series was originally self-published on Jing Jian’s Weibo blog. Currently releasing on Kuaikan Manhua and Bilibili Manhua since July 31, 2021.

title: The Great Ruler
description:
The Great Thousand World. It is a place where numerous planes intersect, a place where many clans live and a place where a group of lords assemble. The Heavenly Sovereigns appear one by one from the Lower Planes and they will all display a legend that others would desire as they pursue the road of being a ruler in this boundless world. In the Endless Fire Territory that the Flame Emperor controls, thousands of fire blazes through the heavens. Inside the Martial Realm, the power of the Martial Ancestor frightens the heaven and the earth. At the West Heaven Temple, the might of the Emperor of a Hundred Battles is absolute. In the Northern Desolate Hill, a place filled with thousands of graves, the Immortal Owner rules the world. A boy from the Northern Spiritual Realm comes out, riding on a Nine Netherworld Bird, as he charges into the brilliant and diverse world. Just who can rule over their destiny of their path on becoming a Great Ruler? In the Great Thousand World, many strive to become a Great Ruler.



(Source: MangaToon)

title: The Unruly Immortals
synonyms: Abnormal Immortal Record of Spooky Daoist
description:
High schooler Li Huowang can close his eyes and be transported to an uncanny world. Over there, he is a medicine primer who will be made into pills by his "Master" at any given time. Meanwhile, in the real world, Li Huowang is living in a mental hospital, unfit to continue school. The doctor told him that the uncanny world is just his hallucinations. What is real, and what is fake? Li Huowang really does not know.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: The Reborn Super Player
description:
Wan Jia, the protagonist, was killed in the game KOG by a sneak attack from his own teammate and therefore disqualified. However, the moment he left the game, he went back to one year ago, the first day of this game. This time he'll never trust anyone easily! This is for revenge! And more importantly, for winning the game!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Straight Girl Trap
description:
Despite her notoriety as a tough boss, Ms. Zhou has a soft spot for Zhan Ying. And it's not like Zhan is complaining! On paper, Ms. Zhou is her perfect partner. There's only one problem: nobody in the office can quite nail down whether Ms. Zhou is straight or actually interested in Zhan. Desperate to find the answer for herself, Zhan begins traversing the minefield that is courting her superior.

(Source: Tapas)

title: A Big Shot Actually
synonyms: Turns Out I’m a Great Cultivator
description:
Li Nianfan transmigrated into the world of immortal cultivation with a mortal body. After learning that he had no talent for cultivation, he settled down to live an ordinary life. But only to find...



The dog he adopted watched his writing and painting, and became the demon lord that ruled half the world. The tree he planted in the backyard listened to him play and sing, and grew into the world tree that held up the bridge between heaven and earth. A casual conversation enlightened a passing traveler to become the immortal sage that defined the era...



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: The Limitless Apostle and the Twelve Battle Maidens
titleRomaji: Wuxian Shitu Yu Shier Zhan Ji
synonyms: Infinite Apostles And Twelve War Girls
description: He is recognized as the strongest existence, standing at the top of the world. Wealth? fame? Power? It was not worth mentioning in his eyes. The strongest apostles fled and startled the human continent for the reason: “Don’t get me wrong! Lao Zi came to look for his future wife! ”Yes, it’s a story about the strongest single apostle ever looking for a wife.

relations.title: Wuxia Shitu Yu Shier Zhan Ji

title: Dragon In My Body
synonyms: I Have a Dragon in My Body
description:
Mo Nan, an Imperial Preceptor in the Celestial Realm, has returned to his senior high days. To his surprise, there is a dragon within him… What would a powerless person do in the face of bullies: fight or obey them? In his past life, Mo Nan did not fight. But he will not make the same mistake! The distinguished Imperial Preceptor lives his new life at will in the modern world while holding onto one principle: a ruler does not serve one!



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Villain Initialization
description:
The villain Ling Chen has a history of hate and violence with the hero, Ye Zimu. Out of nowhere, a reset triggered Ling Chen to return to when he was 17 years old! He has a chance to stop the hero in his path, before Ye Zimu grows to become his worst enemy...



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Pi Chai Shi Nian, Nüxian Gui Di Qiu Wo Shou Ta Wei Tu
titleRomaji: Pi Chai Shi Nian, Nüxian Gui Di Qiu Wo Shou Ta Wei Tu
titleNative: 劈柴十年，女仙跪地求我收她为徒
synonyms: After Ten Years of Chopping Wood, Immortals Begged To Become My Disciples
description:
After ten years of chopping wood (so tired ಠ╭╮ಠ), female immortals (one after another ╮(￣⊿￣)╭) keep coming to kneel down and beg me to take them as disciples! (´ཀ`」 ∠)



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Martial Evolution: The Beast King Awakens
titleRomaji: Gao Wujin Hua: Cong Juexing Guaishou Zhi Wang Kaishi
titleNative: 高武进化：从觉醒怪兽之王开始
synonyms: Martial Evolution: Start by Awakening the King of Monsters
無限進化できる俺は魔獣の力で無双する
description:
Heath Yale awakens in a beast-ravaged world where warriors evolve by absorbing monster genes. Though reborn into a weakling's body, he holds the ultimate cheat—limitless monster templates. From cosmic horrors to cinematic legends, Heath unveils powers the world has never seen.

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Feng Shen Ji III
synonyms: The Legend and the Hero III
Chronicles of the God's Order III
description: The sequel to Feng Shen Ji II.

title: The SSS-Rank Paladin Who Breaks All Rules
synonyms: Paladín de Rango SSS que Transciende el Sentido Común.
SSS-Rank Paladin Who Transcends Common Sense
description:
The game has become reality. Monsters run wild, and every human gets one shot to awaken a class. When Victor Chase awakens, he pulls an S+ talent—"Blessing of the Holy Angel"—and unlocks a hidden class thought to be worthless: the Paladin! Weapon Blessing. Angelic Blessing. Blessing of Honor. One buff after another, his power skyrockets until even the air itself trembles. So... who said Paladins were trash-tier?



(Source: WebComics)

title: I Become A Villain In My Novel
synonyms: Forced to Become the Villain's Son-In-Law
Forced to Become the Villainous Son-in-law
小説の結末を変えないと俺は死ぬ
description:
Because his work stopped updating, a third-rate author was punished into his own novel. In the novel, he is reborn as the villain, Li Yuguo, battling wits and courage with the hero of the original novel. Unexpectedly, he got to know many "confidants"...



(Source: WebComics)

relations.title: Bei Po Chengwei Fanpai Zhuixu Zhi Bing Xue Nüwang

title: Apocalypse Savior
description: Qin Yu was killed a few hundred years into the future during the apocalypse due to a misjudgment. He then traveled back in time before the apocalypse kick off, relying on his battle hardened apocalypse experience and techniques, Qin Yu rapidly developed into a formidable opponent, passing through hurdles, saving the world all while protecting his beloved sister.

title: Rebirth of a Useless Son-in-law in Nirvana
description:
For the sake of finding his missing parents, Qin Li was forced to become mute for ten years to cultivate a technique given to him by a mysterious old man. He was forced to marry into his gorgeous wife's family, but she never treated him well and called him good-for-nothing! But today, those ten years are over! Today, Qin Li is about to change everything!

(Source: WebComics)

title: Martial Master
description:
The legendary martial master Simon was betrayed by friends and persecuted to death. Three hundred years later, he reborn in an illegitimate child of the royal family who was deceived. With his past powers, Simon again creates his legend in this land. Surely, it must be a revenge and reconquer road filled with blood!


(Source: Mangatoon)

title: AISHA
synonyms: Aisha: Ai to Satsuriku no Douwa
Aisha - Contes d'amours et de massacres
description:
Twins who have lost their parents had their inheritance stolen away by their evil stepmother. But the stepmother's three sons have a special feelings towards their non-blood-related stepsisters. Thus, a story of love and hate will unfold in this old mansion. This is a fairy tale of vengeance and romance.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Soul Land 3: Legend of the Dragon King
synonyms: Soul Land III - The Legend of the Dragon King
Douluo Dalu III - The Legend of the Dragon King
Douluo Dalu III: Long Wang Chuanshuo
description:
With advancements in soul technology, humans on the continent of Douluo conquered the oceans and discovered two new continents. The soul beasts have also been hunted to the brink of extinction by human soul masters. The king of soul beasts awakens in the depths of the Great Star Dou Forest to lead remaining clan members to seek vengeance against humankind! Tang Wulin aspires to be a powerful soul master, but when his martial soul awakens, it turns out to be……, Prodigy of an era, battle of the Dragon King, the legend of the Dragon King henceforth begins.


(Source: Wutopia Comics)

relations.title: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
Soul Land - The Legendary Tangs' Hero

title: Rise of The Demon King
description:
Xiao Lang was a young man blessed with a powerful Mystic Soul, but others failed to see its potential. Ridiculed and persecuted for his ""useless"" Soul, he had no choice but to break away from his clan. He would not let anything keep him from achieving his glorious destiny."Even if heaven itself tries to stop me, I'll break through it! Nothing will stand in my way!"
Favorite


(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Baili Jin Among Mortals
description:
Baili Jin, a fairy who was living in heaven, eating and drinking without a care, broke her Majesty’s colourful, stained-glass plate at her birthday and got banished to the mortal realm. Now she has to begin her adventures in the mortal realm with all of her spiritual powers gone! In order to survive, the former fairy has to deliver take-out....



An endearingly silly fairy, a gentle restaurant manager, a reserved top student, and a hard to resist two-faced girl, let the story of their beautiful friendship and youthful days begin!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: The King's Avatar
description:
No one could ever come close to “Battle God” Ye Qiu’s skills in Glory, a popular game that took the world by storm. His professional team, however, replaced him with another captain, and even seized his account. He was left to start anew at an internet cafe as a manager. When a new District 10 opened up in Glory, he dives back, armed with a decade of experience and an unfinished custom weapon. His path to redemption, filled with strategy and memories, marks his thrilling return to the summit.



(Source: Tapas)

title: Guangxiang
description: Two young boys, feel very anxious to face the circumstances of reality, what kind of decision will they take?

title: The Reincarnated Weapon Shop Owner
titleRomaji: Yinwei Wo Shi Kai Wuqi Dian De Dashu
titleNative: 因为我是开武器店的大叔
synonyms: 因为我是武器店的大叔
Because I'm an Uncle Who Runs a Weapon Shop
Because I'm a Weapon Shop Uncle
description:
An average-looking but extraordinarily strong weapon shop owner and a well-behaved but mysterious demon girl. What roles do they play in this ever-changing world?



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Qin Ai De Siduitou
description:
Everyone in the company knows those two women as fierce competitors who fight all the time. But at the company new year's party, they managed to break the ice after a few too many drinks! After that accidental encounter, the sworn enemies begin to have strange feelings about each other…



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Library of Heaven's Path
description:
Traversing into another world, Zhang Xuan finds himself becoming an honorable teacher.


Along with his transcension, a mysterious library appears in his mind.


As long as it is something he has seen, regardless of whether it is a human or an object, a book on its weaknesses will be automatically compiled in the library.


Thus, he becomes formidable.


“Emperor Zhuoyang, why do you detest wearing your underwear so much? As an emperor, can’t you pay a little more attention to your image?”


“Fairy Linglong, you can always look for me if you find yourself unable to sleep at night. I am skilled in lullabies!”


“And you, Demon Lord Qiankun! Can you cut down on the garlic? Are you trying to kill me with that stench?”


This is an incredible story about teachers and students, grooming and guiding the greatest experts in the world!

title: Surviving Disaster：Extreme Cold
description:
While Ice Age is approaching, after being killed by the girl i had a crush on, I was reborn and gained a magical ability. Snacks I ate suddenly turned into plants? Surprisingly, this ability can still be used in other ways too?!... With crises looming, I'll live for myself in this life!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: I’ll Wait for You in 1999
synonyms: I will be waiting for you in 1999
description:
I want to protect you forever... Because you and I have no other loved ones in this world.


The coming-of-age story of two orphans who become best friends.

title: Dark Star King
description:
When Su Xiaobai is dying from an illness, he accidentally comes to another world with the remaining soul of Long Ming, Star King, the strongest human in this world, in his body. He gains the strongest ability called "Infinity of Darkness" at the price of feeling terrible pain whenever he gets an erection. Only when he finds out the person who plotted Long Ming's death and succeeds to the throne can the pain disappear...



(Source: WeComics)

title: Everlasting God of Sword
description:
He stood at the pinnacle of the world. Surpassing all since birth in the art of the sword. But fate has left him crippled moments before reaching the apex. But the story continues and the legend will rise again...


(Source: Mangatoon)

title: Love Like Cherry Blossoms
description:
He knows her secret. She knows his secret too. He is the coolest guy in school. She is the curve wrecker of class. They make a deal in exchange to keep each other's secret. They should be strangers after that promise. But he offers to help her confess to her crush at the same time. Is that true? Is he just teasing her? Or...?



(Source: WebComics)

title: Wo Bixu Chengwei Guaiwu
synonyms: I Have to Be a Monster
description:
Xiao Qiu anonymously defended humanity with all his strength, but he remained unappreciated and misunderstood by everyone. After a life of tragedy, he died and was reborn. This time, he will discard his humanity, and begin his journey to become an unrepentant monster.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Engraved on My Heart
description:
Thanks to the scar on my face and I guess my “vibe,” I always thought I, Qi Shi (Hiro Qi), would end up forever alone. That is until Nan Jue (Duke Nan) made his way into my life! He’s the classmate I saved from bullies (which led to my scar) and it turns out this cheerful, friendly guy works as a wellness guru. Nan Jue's offered to improve my self-image, and help me land my dream job and make new friends. He’s even moved in with me! But I’m starting to learn that even the most perfect smile could be hiding a secret...



(Source: Tapas, edited)



Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Global Examination
description:
This is an examination that puts your life at stake. Answer a plethora of questions, pass the exam, and you may live. Two-faced examiner, Qin Jiu, meets the cold examinee, You Huo. In this inhumane system, both of them who have lost their memories go head to head against each other. Despite that, they have a strong mutual understanding. Alarms go off and the system collapses time and time again. During which, their memories gradually return. It turns out that even at the end of the world where there's only dust left, you're still the first person I met. What's so great about this system? We'll just destroy it. The world is brilliant and grand still, so welcome home.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: The Villainess and Miss Demon Lord
synonyms: The Daughter of Evil and Miss Devil
마법도 못 쓰는 악역 영애로 환생했습니다
description:
Transmigrated as the doomed villainess Aida Mortemer, Yao faces a peculiar challenge in a magical world. Enrolled in a magic academy without magical abilities, her plans to charm the main characters are slightly derailed when she encounters the demon lord's reincarnation. Desperate to survive and avoid her painful demise, Aida also befriends the formidable Miss Demon Lord, only to find her behavior increasingly...odd? Can Aida navigate this magical minefield and get these characters on her side?



(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 8 extra chapters.

title: Perfect Life System: Double Cash for Her Favor
titleRomaji: Caifu Ziyou Hou, Tamen Xianshangle Zhongcheng
titleNative: 财富自由后，她们献上了忠诚
synonyms: After Becoming Financially Free, They Offered Their Loyalty
They Offered Their Loyalty to Me After I Obtained Financial Freedom
description:
Miles Shen had it all—good looks, money, the works. Then everything collapsed. His family empire crumbled, he went from trust fund kid to drowning in debt, and his materialistic girlfriend kicked him to the curb without a backward glance. Just when he's hit absolute rock bottom, he gets the "Perfect Life System". The rules? Spend money on any girl who likes him enough (affection level over 60), and he gets double his money back! And just like that, Miles is living a life where normal people go broke from spending, but he just keeps getting richer. He's throwing money around like it's nothing, and somehow his bank account just keeps growing!



(Source: WebComics)

title: Supreme Zerg Lord: the Catastrophe
titleRomaji: Chongzu Zhuzai: Wo Wan De Jiu Shì Tianzai
titleNative: 虫族主宰：我玩的就是天灾
description:
300 years ago, rifts containing monsters appeared all over the world. Class changers, who consisted of combat, support, and life-type awakened people, fought against the monsters and protected the people. Out of the four grades of class changers, divine is the rarest, appearing once in a century, which is why all eyes were on Chen Jiang, the first divine class changer in a century. However, expectations were turned into disappointment when he awakened into the most unpopular type, the life type. However, for some reason, Chen Jiang seems quite content with what happened...



(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Rise of the Mountain Chief
description:
Our protagonist embarks on a journey from a humble mountain village, accompanied by two companions: a strategist and a groom. His goal is to transform the village into the strongest mountain stronghold. He arrives in a chaotic world where he inherits a dilapidated mountain fortress. In the face of this tumultuous and deadly environment, he faces a critical choice: Will he resort to robbing money, food, and women to become a carefree king of the mountain? Or will he pour his heart and soul into battling the heroes of the world, striving to earn a name that will echo throughout the universe? Is anyone truly born destined to be a king, duke, general, or minister?



(Source: Webnovel)

title: A Beginner with the Mightiest Account
titleRomaji: Kaiju Jiu You Wang Zhe Zhanghao
synonyms: It Starts with a Kingpin Account
There is a King Account at the Start
Start to Have the King Account
description:
The sudden crisis brought the earth directly into the OL era, and all mankind was under the influence of mysterious forces. Everyone became a level-one newbie. In this cruel dog-eat-dog world, the high school student Ye Hao could only rise to level three. When he was about to die, he accidentally triggered the king's account upgrade system, can Ye Hao become the strongest king?



(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

relations.title: Kaiju Jiu You Wang Zhe Zhanghao

title: The Almighty Demon Lord, Resurrected!
synonyms: The Rebirth Of The Demon God
description: The Almighty Demon Lord, Resurrected!: The once-reigning demon lord, Lord Shitian, was betrayed by his confidantes during his critical ascension to become a demon saint. With the combined powers of the Five Benevolent Sects, the demon lord was vanquished. Just when the world thought it was rid of the demon lord, he reincarnates into the body of the disciple Mo Fan. With his body weakened and power lost, the demon lord can only wait patiently as he recuperates. This time, combining both demonic and human energy, he will rise again stronger than ever! Under the noses of the so-called Five Benevolent Sects, Lord Shitian embarks on a journey of vengeance, bloody retribution, extermination, ridding the world of all evil, and ultimately reclaiming his throne as the almighty demon lord!

title: Whose Baby is it?
titleRomaji: Nali Lai De Da Bao Bei
description:
According to the fortune-teller, I was born to be unlucky...was he kidding me?! My child owns the super power that can turn calamities into blessings through dreams! But the bossy president suddenly claimed that he's the natural father of my babe?! And he even kidnapped me and my child?!



(Source: Webcomics)



Note: Includes 23 extra chapters.

title: Immortal Lord Reborns In The City
description:
He was the paragon of cultivation, on the verge of immortality, but instead he abused his sect's ultimate technique to reverse time, back to his life in the city! This time, he will right his wrongs and make up for all of his past regrets. This time, he will have wealth, power, and women!



(Source: Tencent, translated)



Note: Main storyline was completed with 414 chapters on 2023-09-27. Subsequent special chapters are being released periodically.

title: I'm More Dangerous Than You
description:
When Jiang Wanshu met Ren Pingsheng, what she thought was her light, became the beginning of her nightmare. As a teacher, Ren Pingsheng seems gentle and considerate on the outside, but is secretly an extremely passionate reader of Jiang Wanshu's book. What seemed to be a "coincidental" first encounter was in truth calculated and planned.



Behind the peaceful days, the crazy reader has begun her hunt...



(Source: Bilibili Comics)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title: I Have 999 Types of Supernatural Powers
synonyms: I Can Snatch 999 Types of Abilities
description:
In a world where superpowers are commonplace, Yang Xifa swore bloody revenge on those who harmed his dear sister. He will use his ability to take away other's powers to build himself up from an innocent bystander to become the leader of a powerful organization. Combining his strength and smarts to defeat the evil-doers, he will collect 999 abilities and become the most powerful hero in the world!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Omega Heroine Wants Her Alpha Villainess
titleRomaji: Bai Yueguang Nü Zhu Zong Xiang Duzhan Wo
titleNative: 白月光女主总想独占我
synonyms: Perfect Heroine Wants to Possess Me
description:
After a biking mishap, Willow Ji lands in an Omegaverse novel as a doomed Alpha villainess. To avoid a shark-infested fate, she navigates cautiously around Serena Wei, the Omega heroine, aiming to win her heart with kindness. Initially suspicious, Serena gradually warms up to Willow, even harboring feelings for her. As the lines between protagonist and antagonist blur, the question arises: when will Willow realize that their feelings are mutual, and her "foe" has also fallen deeply for her?



(Source: Tapas)

authors.name: Gezi Bu Hui Gu Gu Gu

title: An Ambiguous Feeling
description:
High school student Yang Ming is a typical underachiever. He gets into fights, skips class, and cheats on his schoolwork. When the school flower confronts him, he feels ashamed and wants to change, but he has fallen too far behind.
However, by a stroke of fate, he ends up gaining a pair of contacts that allow him to change his visual perspective, completely altering the course of his future!



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Dark Hunter
description:
Chen Beiming, a young member of the Star Alliance, was assassinated under the order of the Five Emperors. Unexpectedly, his soul went back to the past of 10 years ago, granting him the chance to change his destiny, as well as to take his revenge on those who was behind his death.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: My Three Thousand Years To The Sky
description:
At the age of seventeen, Bai already reached level ten of the Qi Refining stage, just about to breakthrough. What a genius! 



Three thousand years later, Bai has already reached level 66,66a of Qi Refining… yet… there’s still no sign of breaking through at all. From Grandmaster to “Grand-Monster”, he can still be a bad*ss even when stuck on the newbie stage for three thousand years!



(Source: Mangatoon)



Note: Includes a bonus CNY chapter and a seven-chapter side story.

relations.title: Dao Mo: Lian Qi Lianle Sanqian Nian Waizhuan

title: Counterattack of the Superrich House Husband
description:
Han Sanqian has been married into the Su clan for three years, but he was called a trash son-in-law and treated like a doormat by the other relatives. In order to protect his wife Su Yingxia from further humiliation, Han Sanqian worked secretly to become a super son-in-law in preparation for some payback.



(Source: Manman, translated)

title: Contracting Myself
synonyms: I Made a Contract With Myself
description:
Zhang Ping is tired of being seen as powerless, so he takes matters into his own hands by contracting himself with a forbidden gem. Now, with evolving powers and new challenges around every corner, he’s stepping into a world full of dangerous beasts and unpredictable enemies. His journey to survive and grow stronger has just begun.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: My Fake Girlfriend's Defending Against Their Attack
titleRomaji: Wo De Jia Nüyou Zheng Quanli Fangyu Tamen De Jingong
titleNative: 我的假女友正全力防御她们的进攻
synonyms: My Fake Girlfriends are using me as a Shield
description:
One day, a girl suddenly confessed to me. In order to reject her, I had to find a fake girlfriend. I didn’t expect that my plan to avoid trouble… would lead to an even bigger mess? The Archery Club's tsundere "Mad Dog”, the flirtatious “White Fox”, the long-black-haired “Unattainable Flower”, and… my yandere bro-con sister! How did my youthful love story come to this?



(Source: Billibilli, translated)

title: King of Martial Arts
description:
Being kicked out by the sect? Being humiliated by fellows? And being alienated by my lover?  None of those could stop me, even if my inner power pool is broken. Wait when I reach the top and become the king of martial arts!



(Source: MangaToon)

title: It All Starts with Playing Game Seriously
titleRomaji: Cong Renzhen Wan Youxi Kaishi Jueqi
titleNative: 从认真玩游戏开始崛起
synonyms: It All Starts With Playing Game Seriously
description:
When the world of the online game Yuanjie became reality, people obtained their in-game abilities in real life, and the world descended into chaos. Liu Yi, patient and strong but afraid of fighting, was reborn to the time before the game became reality, and will now have to play the game seriously and overcome his fear of fighting, in order to become the savior to overcome this doomsday crisis.



(Source: QQ, translated)

title: When Did I Become Unbeatable?
description:
He always thought he was just an ordinary guy, but he didn’t know that his yard was full of divine artifacts and the chickens he raised were actually phoenixes! It wasn’t until after five years of living in an ordinary village when the System finally allowed him to come into contact with cultivators. It was then that he discovered that no matter how strong someone was, the moment they saw him, they would be so intimidated that they would tremble in fear. Some would even kneel down and call him master…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: The Daily Life of Immortal King
description:
It is an era where everyone is a cultivator except for Wang Ling. He doesn't care about cultivation, elixirs, and whatnot, yet he shows an aptitude for martial arts. He picks up sword skills at three and attains Godhood at five. Despite his efforts to keep a low profile, he quickly makes a name for himself.

(Source: WebComics)

relations.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King

animeInIndex.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King

title: The Evil Ring
synonyms: ブラックチョーカー・神の子の逆襲
description:
Born in the ruthless Exile Land where his next meal was never guaranteed, Moon has always aspired to no longer be a worthless human stuck at the edges of society. And while a once in a lifetime opportunity may pay out enough money to let him live his dreams, his road to riches is paved with games of death and survival. Can Moon survive long enough to see better days?

(Source: Tapas)

title: The Ultimate Summoner
titleRomaji: Zhi You Wo Neng Yong Zhao Huan Shu
description:
Zayn Ze travels to a parallel universe where people grow stronger by fighting monsters in the Demon Realm to prevent them from invading the Summer Nation, the real world where he currently resides. To protect his sister Nina, Zayn enters the Demon Realm under the alias "Loki." However, he unexpectedly awakens with the rare and overpowered SSS-level Summoning Skill! This ability allows him to summon and control every monster he defeats. As his Summoning Skill grows stronger, it becomes a trump card that can tip the balance in this dangerous world!


(Source: WebComics)

title: Conglíngkaishi Wuxian Jinhua
description:
Use it all, break through limits. Innate wisdom, academic pinnacle. Multiple forms, transcending evolution. Reborn, starting from scratch, infinitely evolving.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Heaven Defying Sword
description: To defeat his uncle who destroyed his family, the teenager Xuan Tian embarked on a martial arts training journey to hone his sword techniques. From a teenager who knew nothing to a Sword God of his generation, those he once saw as strong are now mere specks of dust to him. With one finger, I obliterate all; With my sword, I defy the heavens! And his path, leads him directly to the limitless heavens!

title: Wo You Jiuqianwan-yi Tian Gou Jin
titleRomaji: Wo You Jiuqianwan-yi Tian Gou Jin
synonyms: I Have Nine Quadrillion Simp Gold Coins
description:
Chen Yuan, a college boy, worshiped Lin Shutong like a goddess for three years, but he was treated like a loser and kicked to the curb. In despair, he accidentally activated the Simping Fund system. It gave him an account with nine quadrillion dollars. This money can only be used to simp for women. The more you spend, the more rewards you will get back, and you can also earn various attribute bonuses to eventually become a super-boy.



It’s called the Simping Fund System, but do I want to be a simp? If I spend enough, I'll be the king here. With enough money to prove my love, I can make those goddesses simp for me! With this new realization, Chen Yuan will embark on a remarkable new life!



(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

title: Great Mage of Light
description: Zhang Gong decides to learn light magic, a magic few show interest in and eventually becomes the legendary Grand Mage. While trying to end the continent's east and west separation in order to unite all of the different races, he becomes every race's Child of Light.

relations.title: Soul Land - The Legendary Tangs' Hero

title: My Mobster Girlfriend
synonyms: Wo de Fan Pai Nv You
description:
Zhang Nan, the young master of the Hidden Dragon Family, wanted to become an ordinary person, but he was sent to the aristocratic training school by his grandfather. When he was assigned to an all-female class by a confused teacher, Zhang Nan finds himself tortured by these heirs to the brink of dropping out..



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Ting Xing
description:
Having failed in her attempts to become a voice actor, Chi Yu no longer talks about it with other people. Now she just listens to yuri drama podcasts in secret. One day, during a university lecture, she discovers that Yu Chen, a girl from another college, has the same voice as the main character in her favorite sexy yuri podcast…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Erha He Tade Baimao Shizun
synonyms: Dumb Husky and his White Cat Shizun
Erha and His White Cat Master
Erha and His White Cat Teacher
description:
Emperor of the cultivation world Mo Weiyu deceived elders and slaughtered ancestors, and committed all crimes and sins known to man. After ending his own life, he was reborn and transmigrated to the year he first became a disciple.



In the shell of a boy held an old and weary soul. After coming back to life, truth after truth that had been hidden below the surface in the previous life floated to the top and broke through the waters one after the other.



Of all revelations, the one that stunned him the most was that the Shizun he had hated to the bone in his previous life had always been protecting him from the shadows...



The heart of a man can change; even demons and monsters can become compassionate and do good. Only, he had sinned deeply. Can the blood on his hands ever be cleansed?

title: The Glutton: Devourer of Kings
synonyms: จอมเขมือบกู้โลก
description:
Humanity's world was destroyed by the Demon Kings. Stripped of everything, Awakener Ash Si sacrificed himself in a devastating explosion to drag Demon King Voralune, The Glutton, down to hell. Instead of death, he opens his eyes ten years in the past, long before the tragedy occurred. He discovers his powers have awakened early, and surprisingly, he also possesses Voralune’s power of Gluttony. Armed with this advantage, Ash decides to act in advance. With his return, everything in the world seems to be changing...

(Source: WEBTOON)

title: Fairies Cultivation Manual
synonyms: Yao Jing Zhong Zhi Shou Ce
description:
"So many demon spirits, I want to collect them." Long Ao Tian. Yuan Ding, goes on a journey of collecting demon spirits
.

title: The Time of Rebirth
titleRomaji: Wo Bei Kun Zai Tong Yi Tian Shiwan Nian
titleNative: 我被困在同一天十万年
synonyms: I was Stuck on the Same Day for One Hundred Thousand Years
十万年の無限ループから脱出した
Mười Vạn Năm Bị Nhốt Trong Cùng Một Ngày
description:
When Lin Yue was transported to the Hong Meng Continent, he was forced to live the same day for 100,000 years. No matter how much he struggled, he would still return to the same day at sunrise. In a hundred millennia, Lin Yue learned everything there was to know about the world, unlocking the secrets of countless mighty warriors from numerous sects.Gradually, he had to accept the fact that he would never escape his endless loop of reincarnation.However, on the final day of the 100,000th year, Lin Yue snatched away the Seven Demons Emperor’s fiancée and chopped off the arm of a sect elder’s son. After stirring up such a catastrophe, he suddenly found that a brand-new day had opened its doors for him…


(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Log In with Max Level
titleRomaji: Qiandao 30 Tian Yi Quan Bao Xing
synonyms: After Signing in for 30 Days, I Can Annihilate Stars
Signed 30 Days and I Can Destroy a Star With One Punch
description:
Struggling with his sister's illness and unjustly framed by his boss, Mo Chu's life suddenly turns when he's unexpectedly chosen as a savior in the "Secret Realm." With the looming threat of the Beast Lord's invasion, Mo is the only non-cultivator among powerful cultivators. Luckily, fate grants the Check-In System, bestowing him unparalleled power. Yet challenges linger in the real world with vengeful cultivators and a ferret beast set on his demise. Is this power a disguised blessing or...?

(Source: Tapas)

title: Dushi Xiaoxiong Xitong
description: Jiang Bai was killed in a truck accident when trying to escape from a high risk casino after winning a huge amount of money but instead of dying, his soul was transported into a parallel world that is similar to Earth and merge with his alternate pathetic self. Over there he met the mad god who grant him a powerful BUG ability in this new world. Jiang Bai is now stuck in his alternate world self, who is far weaker and less more influential than the original him. Can he make a comeback in this new parallel earth with his new cheat abilities?

title: Hunter Age
synonyms: HunterAge～ドラゴンハンターの冒険～
description:
The story happens on the Dragonrealm continent. Heron, the protagonist of the story, was born in a remote village. After seeing hunting skills beyond his power, he decides to go on an adventure for further advancement, and soon his journey is accompanied by cruel enemies as well as faithful friends. At the same point, the continent is undergoing a monstrous conspiracy. As the mysterious robot and the dark forces appear, an epic war is about to start.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: My Passive Skills Hit Like a Truck
titleRomaji: Wo Kao Wudi Beidong Da Chu Cheng Dun Shanghai!
titleNative: 我靠无敌被动打出成吨伤害！
synonyms: I Rely on My Invincibility to Deal Tons of Damage Passively!
description:
In his past life, Edmund Cheng clawed his way to the top of "Apocalypse," earning god-tier titles in every class, only to fall one step short of becoming the world's number one. Death wasn't the end. He wakes in a new world, running on the exact same rules as "Apocalypse," except now it's real, and everyone gets one shot at awakening a class. While others are still fumbling through the basics, Edmund already knows every hidden class, every secret path. He's done this before. Now, armed with the glory he never got to claim, he'll forge a path no one has ever walked—and this time, he'll take his place at the top.



(Source: WebComics)

title: The Divine Ring Descends: The Strongest Otherworld
titleRomaji: Shen Jie Jianglin: Zui Qiang Yi Shijie
titleNative: 神戒降临: 最强异世界
synonyms: Become the Strongest Hero Through the Cheat System
The Boundless Ring's Champion Unleashed in Another World
Divine Ring Arrives: The Strongest Otherworld
description:
When darkness invades the city, zillions of human warriors come into being, but Aiden isn't one of them. One day, he comes across a mysterious ring and is sent into the Orc Realm where humans are forbidden, by a treaty. He magically survives his execution, lifts the Orc Tribe's sacred hammer, and becomes the tribe leader. Just then, he is transported back to his original reality.



(Source: WebComics)

title: Myriad Realms Gatekeeper
description:
When the planet perishes and the gods fall, the collapse of the magical realm leaves humanity without any protectors. Now, "Anomalies" and "Catastrophes" begin to invade the human realm . As the Dark Age descends, a soul from Blue Star (Earth) is unexpectedly transported into this dying realm.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Guowang Wansui
description: An ordinary student accidentally traveled into an other universe and became the king of a small kingdom. He had gotten a “Cheating Code” of life and was able to complete something extraordinary. This is the story about a king that was able to conquer continents and leave behind him an ultimate legend that will be recited between every generation to come.

title: I'm a Loser, Baby
description:
Being looked down on, divorced, and killed—maybe that’s the life of a loser after all... However, I was reborn by Cang Kunzi, the best cultivator in the world of immortal cultivation. If that’s the case, I may as well make the best out of this situation. Watch how I use this body of a loser to crush all of you powerless bunch!



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Master of Legendary Realms
synonyms: Deity's Path through Ten Thousand Realms
Deity's Path Through Ten Thousand Worlds
The Immortal remains of Ten Thousand Realms
The Immortal remains of Ten Thousand Worlds
description:
Every world is like a flower, The secular realm as we know it is but a speck of dust in the hands of deities and demons. One moment for them, a thousand years in the mortal world. Even mountain ranges and vast oceans are but mere illusions.


The Tianyuan God Sect was once the mightiest sect in the great Dashang. Ye Xingyun’s master and also the sect leader of the Tianyuan God Sect, Diejiu ascends to become a deity and leaves the sect in the hands of Yi Xingyun who’s cultivation has stagnated due to missing one of the eight veins.

title: I Have Been Trapped In This Day for Three Thousand Years
titleRomaji: Wo Kun Zai Zhe Yi Tian Yi Sanqian Nian
titleNative: 我困在这一天已三千年
synonyms: I Have Been Stuck On The Same Day For 3,000 Years?
同じ日を三千年繰り返したら強くなり過ぎた
description:
Lu Feng has spent the last 3000 years reliving the exact same day over and over again. His only solace throughout the millennia has been rescuing his teammates each and every time he's forced to repeat the clearing of the shadow world. But when Lu obtains a mysterious item after what seemed like another routine completion, he finds himself waking up in his room and beginning a brand new day!

(Source: Tapas)

title: The First Order
description:
In an apocalyptic world where cutting-edge technology is a relic of the past, despite his illness, Xiaosu hunts to get through each day and support his brother Liuyuan, who has a special ability related to luck. However, one day, Xiaosu unlocks a palace that offers quests in return for strength and skills. As he starts to grow while completing the quests, he starts to wonder what the palace actually is and whether he'll be able to bring down the barrier that divides the powerful from the powerless one day with his newfound power.



(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Super Cube
description:
Just an average joe with a crush on the school goddess, Wang Xiaoxiu's life takes a polar plunge when he becomes the target of a jealous gang leader. One frigid dip in the river later, he teleports away with a mysterious cube: a gateway to the Ultimate Universe System. Thrust into a world of superpowers, Xiaoxiu embraces his newfound abilities and embarks on a quest for avenging wrongdoings. He paves his path not as your average joe, but as a rising hero forged in the icy waters of fate.



(Source: Tapas)

title: Xing Jia Hun Jiang Zhuan
description:
Song Yunxiang, humanity's final mecha-sorceror, was reborn back to his schoolboy days with a powerful System. Last time when he was young, he was shunned for his lack of spiritual constitution. Because he was weak, he could only watch as his friends and comrades died in the oncoming war. In this life, he returns with a System along with 60 years of combat experience and technical knowledge. This time, back on campus, he will use his newfound power to create new mecha and destroy the monsters… All his regrets, all the friends that he missed, this time he will not make the same mistakes.



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: I, the Strongest Demon, Have Regained My Youth?!
titleRomaji: Zui Qiang Mo Jun De Wo Turan Bian Xiao Le
titleNative: 最强魔君的我，突然变小了?!
description:
In order to maintain his rule, Xin Sheng, the eternal demon king who ruled the world, went deep into the demon realm to find the highest and strongest power. Thousands of years later, he has become stronger and younger, and the world has also changed...



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Super Gene
description:
In the future, countless alien beasts will invade across the universe. Humans that devour the alien flesh can absorb their genetic powers, which ushered in an era of rapid genetic evolution. Han Sen, a newcomer to the base, became known as the "butt fiend" and despised by others. But in secret, he's actually the overpowered "B God" admired by everyone! Han Sen: Sorry, only I can take on the ultimate god-gene!



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: I Get A Random New Occupation Every Week
titleRomaji: Wo Mei Zhou Suiji Yi Ge Xin Zhiye
titleNative: 我每周随机一个新职业
synonyms: I Get An All-career Experience System
I Randomly Have a New Career Every Week
description:
When Lin Yi was fired from his job, he triggered the Career Experience System by accident. The System offered Lin Yi various career opportunities and generous rewards for completing its missions. He took advantage of those rewards to achieve his ambitions of skills, riches, and power.



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Shen Wu Tianzun
synonyms: Rebirth Of The Supreme God Physique
description: I was once the Supreme God of Physique, standing tall above others. However, I was betrayed by those whom I thought of as my most trustworthy friends. They had schemed against me in an attempt to kill me, which was almost successful. Fortunately, a fraction of my soul had managed to escape into the body of a seriously injured child giving me another chance at life, and revenge.

title: Run Wild
description:
As soon as Jiang Cheng finds out he’s adopted, he’s abandoned by his adoptive family and sent to live with his deadbeat father, who has a gambling addiction. Everything about his new life, from his pathetic father to the unfamiliar environment, makes Jiang Cheng depressed. But then he meets Gu Fei, who’s like a shining bright light in this run-down city, and the two become each other’s salvation and hope.



(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Shen Ze
description: From an early age, Xu Shenze would often get caught up in the same strange dream. Over time, the dark shadow that the dream cast over his life grew, until, one day, the shadow became real, and suddenly Xu Shenze's life as he knew it was completely torn to shreds. His parents suddenly meet a gruesome end, and all sorts of other strange and disturbing events kept on happening to him. Alone and afraid, when he hears about a supposed "dream town", he decides to go there to look for answers. In the town that is called both the "Holy Land" and "Purgatory" by its residents, what sort of terrible truths are waiting for Xu Shenze?

title: Virtual World: Close Combat Mage
description: Due to a mistake on his student’s part, a super Martial Artist received the wrong class in an online game and has become a mage. He, who was used to curbing violence with violence and using strength to subdue strength, could only make the best out of this mistake. Taking on a new lease in life, he became a violent close combat mage. When strength and magic came perfectly together, a new gaming path had been opened by him!

title: Formless Form
description:
A story about a Maoshan Master fighting against demons! An invincible Maoshan Taoist meets a girl working part-time jobs who's in trouble


(Source: WeComics)

title: Counterattack Through Pregnancy
titleRomaji: Ao Jiao Nai Ba Xiuxiang Tao
synonyms: Ni Xi Zhi Hao Yun Ren Sheng
The Art of Taming His Husband
description:
Having a two-faced bitch as a rival in love isn’t scary. What’s scary is that the bitch has the upper hand—reincarnating as his little brother! Due to his little brother, his lover cheated on him, his grandfather suffered a violent death, his family business was taken over, and on top of all that he was framed and thrown into prison.



Just as he thought he’d hit bottom, he somehow got laid by a man and became pregnant on the night before his release. After he got out of prison, he came back anew; he opened a restaurant, engaged in cultivation, and made a fortune while raising his child. He lived a vibrant life, but certainly didn’t forget to seek revenge…



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Laopo Qing An Fen
description:
A new sister work from the same team that authored My wife is from a thousand years ago!
If you could go back in time, what would you do?



I would wait for you at the school gate, wait there every day, and relentlessly pursue you until I win you over. What about you?



Hmm... I would wait patiently until I turn twenty-four to meet you again, then proceed step-by-step with dating, marriage, and then I can ask you this question again. I'm proceeding cautiously because I'm afraid the butterfly effect will cause me to lose you."



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

relations.title: My Wife Is from a thousand Years ago

title: Frenzy Leveling Up System
description:
Despite being the young lord of Merak Palace, Yi Tianyun is considered a weakling and an outcast by all those around him. The only person who cares about him is the master of the palace and his aunt, Shi Xueyun. After another day of training without much progress, Tianyun receives a special dragon blood elixir from Xueyun to replenish his health. But upon consuming it, he’s thrown into the “Frenzy Leveling Up System,” which allows him to finally gain the boost in power he’s always wanted. Now armed with a trove of incredible skills and items, is there any opponent who stands a chance against him? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Martial Rebel
description:
On the Tianwu Continent, the strong commands the weak. The young master of the Feng family Feng Hao, owns a unique physique but was mistakenly thought to be a failure in cultivation. He was chastised and humiliated constantly because of that. A chance meeting transformed him completely and ultimately altered his fate. He contoured his body with rare gems and eventually achieved invincibility. He was set on the path to conquering the void and rampaging through the universe!



(Source: BiliBili Comics)

title: Let Me Game in Peace
titleRomaji: Wo Zhi Xiang Anjing De Da Youxi
synonyms: I Just Want to Game in Peace
I Just Want to Play Games Quietly
description:
Other players have to grind for every HP and every life in this game, while I can just one-shot people. When dimensional rifts appeared, areas around the globe became occupied by supernatural beings as spirits, buddahs, demons, angels, and faeries all descending upon the Earth. For some reason, all these mysterious extra-dimensional realms became dungeons in my mobile game. While other adventurers risk their lives, I'm just here playing my game.



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Demon Lord: My Twists with Female Disciples
titleRomaji: Da Ai Mozun, Nü Tudi Dou Xiang Sha Wo
titleNative: 大爱魔尊，女徒弟都想杀我
synonyms: I Love the Demon Lord So Much That Even My Female Disciples Want to Kill Me
I, the Demon Lord Am Being Targeted by My Female Disciples!
転生魔尊が狙われています
description:
Bai Feng gets sucked into a romance game, and guess who he becomes? The notorious Dark Overlord, Bai Qingling. In this world, Bai Qingling's the ultimate bad guy: cold, ruthless, obsessed with immortality, and known for dark cultivation and making human puppets. And to top it off, he sees his three female disciples as nothing but pawns. Basically, he's the final boss everyone hates. Now, Bai Feng's gotta use the [Universal Love System] to flip this script and survive. Watch as he turns this nightmare into something else entirely.

(Source: WebComics)

title: Eternal Love
description:
When Wen Yifan returns to her hometown for work, she runs into the super hot guy everyone's talking about. However, this super hottie turns out to be Sang Yan, the guy whose feelings she crushed when she rejected him back in high school! In a twist of fate, two paths that remained separate all that time now seem to be intertwined as they keep bumping into each other. What's more, they coincidentally end up renting the same apartment and becoming roommates! Watch how Sang Yan, dubbed the "perfect boyfriend”, navigates his way through love amidst a whirlwind of unspoken feelings and strong emotions!



(Source: Pocket Comics)

title: Ultimate Son-in-law
description:
Shen Lang transmigrated into another world as a man who married into a wealthy family. However, the clan saw him as a useless wastrel so they kicked him out. Now he's determined to take revenge on them by finding a wife who's prettier, stronger, and have a more powerful title. But he won't be cultivating his own martial arts skills, because there's no way he's any good at it. Instead, he's going to help his wife become the world's strongest fighter, and let her beat up anyone who dares to stand in his way!



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Yi Huang Chongsheng
description: Reiki is a resurrection, the entire world is covered by a strong aura, and creatures of the earth are affected by this. Humans experienced an account that they had stronger powers, and other creatures besides humans also evolved rapidly under the influence of Aura. Some powerful and mysterious races have appeared in silence. The legend says that the power remained: the family in another world, coincidentally, the soul of another world royal prince entered the body of a young common human, Huang Shang, and began the story of bloody and funny hegemony...

title: Xiao Gu Niang
description:
"I think I could fall in love with you."


"You're cute like a little pony."


A love story between the cute but flighty elder girl "Little Fox" and the younger but more mature "Young Pony." See how they flourish both in love and in life!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Wo De Nü Tudi Men Dou Shi Weilai Zhu Tian Dalao
titleRomaji: Wo De Nü Tudi Men Dou Shi Weilai Zhu Tian Dalao
titleNative: 我的女徒弟们都是未来诸天大佬
synonyms: 諸天聖者〜崩壊世界と女弟子〜
My Female Apprentices Are All Big Shots From the Future
My Female Disciples are all Future Masters of the Heavens
description:
The historical timeline is facing collapse, and the strongest Taoist master was sent back to one hundred thousand years ago with his entire body of cultivation. Ding~ Your system-assigned mission is here, it's up to you to entice all the female apprentices!



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Junk to King: I Am A Scavenger
titleRomaji: Wo Kao Jian Lese Shang Wang Zhe
synonyms: I Became the King By Scavenging
description:
You've received a hidden job. Processing… Congratulations, Scavenger! Typhon Ye couldn’t afford to repay the high-interest loans that plagued him after a few failed investments, so his loan shark made him do illegal work for private parties to repay his debts. On one fateful day, Typhon struck down a monster he should never have been able to, and in that instant, experience points surged within him! He’d leveled up from Lv. 0 to Lv. 1! Typhon had triggered his once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to get a job! But the hands of fate had another plan for him, he awakened to a job unheard of in history -Scavenger! A “unique” job that revolves entirely around junk!



(Source: WebComics)

title: Wang You: Gua Ji Baiwan Nian, Wo Xinglai Cheng Shen
titleRomaji: Wang You: Gua Ji Baiwan Nian, Wo Xinglai Cheng Shen
titleNative: 网游：挂机百万年，我醒来成神
synonyms: I Awoke as a God After Auto Battling For a Million Years
Idle Player Returns as a God
After Millions of Year’s I Woke Up To Be A God!
description:
When a rift opened to another world, monster rushed through the portal, overwhelming cities as humanity faced apocalyptic ruin! Humanity was forced to take up cultivation, as every nation sought to cultivate powerful heroes to conquer the other-world for fame and fortune! The most powerful warrior of the Dragon Realm, who had slept for a million years, has reawakened with a million years' worth of XP and other resources that had accumulated during his slumber. Now even the most powerful other-world Boss will tremble in fear, and all the Tier 0 heroes from across the world will kneel in respect…



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Heresy
description:
The society calls the teaching of Yuhun Sect as “Heresy," which relying on the technique to tame spiritual beasts using magic tools.
For Mo Lianjian, a young disciple who lost his parents since a little, expertise on the practice is a struggle especially when his genius childhood friend, Lian Beibei always tries to pick a fight.
One day, Mo obtained a fragment of a legendary sword which rumored to be owned by the last swordsman of Yuhun Sect...



(Source: manga.club)

title: Vampire Princess X Knight
synonyms: The Blood Princess and the Knight
description:
As a holy knight, I was captured after losing in a battle against vampires. "Huhu~ Kill you? Keep dreaming and receive my Embrace. In the future, please give me lots of guidance, my beloved daughter~" The silvery-haired loli vampire queen gently lifted my chin and smirked in amusement, her sharp fangs aiming for my neck.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Qinai De L
description: Dr. Wei struggles after finding out that the girl she hooked up with was only sixteen years old, but somehow it's not as easy to avoid the girl as she had thought.

title: The Making Of A Miraculous Doctor
synonyms: The Rise of the Prodigy Surgeon
description:
Ran Ling, who aspires to become the world's greatest doctor, suddenly activates the "system"! Little does he know, it's a system with a plethora of medical expertise! What kind of medical heights can Ran Ling, a mere trainee, obtain with the help of the system?



(Source: Tapas)

title: Honkai Impact 3rd
description:
A Manhua of the popular smartphone game Honkai 3rd launched by miHoYo 



「Collapse」 ... An unknown force once known bury the civilization of mankinds in the distant past ... now descended into this peaceful world once again.



"Honkai, the mysterious power responsible for destroying human civilization countless times, has descended upon this beautiful world once again…” With the lands now flooded with deadwalkers and Honkai beasts, a group of girls bearing the burdens of despair continue their fight onward. Will there be any hope of clinging to survival?"



Three years ago, the third Honkai descended upon Chuangai City in the far east... Under the glow of sunset, Valkyrie Kiana leapt out from the Hyperion, plummeting through the clouds like a falling meteor towards a warship. Her relentless Valkyrie determination represented a glimmer of hope. With this breathtaking scene, the story of the Captain and the Hyperion begins and the stage is set for the battle with the Honkai. Fight for all that is beautiful in this world!

relations.title: Golden Courtyard: New Year Wishes in Winter
Honkai: Star Rail - Ichor of Two Dragons
Journey Crisis! The St. Freya Special Event

title: Lord of The Apocalypse
description:
Centuries ago, the emergence of a monster-filled tower heralded the apocalypse. Only clearing the tower can save the world and Xiao Lin, the light of humanity, is the only one capable of such a feat. Unfortunately for him, this is not his story. After being one-shot by the monster king, the legend of Xiao Lin comes to an end and Demon Lord Ming Jiu's begins.

(Source: Tapas)

title: Fengaotian Xiaoshuo Li De Huangmao Fanpai Ye Xiang Xingfu
titleRomaji: Fengaotian Xiaoshuo Li De Huangmao Fanpai Ye Xiang Xingfu
titleNative: 凤傲天小说里的黄毛反派也想幸福
synonyms: The Blonde-Haired Villain in Girl Overlord Novel Also Longs for Happiness
The Yellow-Haired Villain in the Female Main Character's Novel Wants Happiness
The Yellow-Haired Villain in Soaring Phoenix's Novels Also Desires Happiness
description:
Transmigrating into the body of a blonde-haired villain at the start of a yuri novel, Mu En just wanted to survive. But… why does the story seem to be going off track?



The princess is drugged and unclothed — so why hasn't the heroine shown up to save her yet? Why does the heroine’s childhood friend, a noble and pure saint, keep giving me flirtatious looks? Even my obedient personal maid has started looking at me in alarming ways!



Where is the heroine?! Please save me!!



"If you're going steal my women, you better be prepared to take responsibility…" the protagonist told me, with a kind smile on her face and a sharp machete in her hand.



(Source: SFACG, translated)

title: Closer Heartbeat
synonyms: A Step Closer to Your Heart
description:
Su Ye never thought of her perfect childhood friend Zheng Shu in a romantic way until recently. Normally standoffish and introverted, she isn't sure what to do with these unfamiliar feelings. Even when they hang out like they always do, it doesn't feel the same anymore... For now, all Su Ye can do is try to become better at communicating with people!
 


(Source: Comikey)



Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

title: Book of Yaoguai
description: A foxy temptress. A strange misty tree demon. A girl with the power of the goddess Xianjia! Being caught between these women is a feat in it of itself, but our hero Feng Xi must fight in order to protect the peace and save the world!

title: Song of the Sky Pacers
description:
During the Chen dynasty, Consort Jing gave birth to a pair of fraternal twins under the rays of sunlight. The prince was born with a cinnabar mole between his eyebrows, while the princess was born with six fingers. Fortune and misfortune appeared at the same time, causing the twins to experience entirely different fates as they were forced to leave their family. The heavenly tribulation is approaching, will the two twins who were separated from birth ever get to be reunited? What methods would they use to fight against their destinies?



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: This Villain Emperor's Gotta Charm the Male Lead to Survive!
titleRomaji: Chuan Yue Cheng Fanpai Yao Ruhe Huo Ming
titleNative: 穿越成反派要如何活命
synonyms: How To Survive As A Villain
Chuan Cheng Qiujin Nan Zhu De Fanpai Tao Ruhe Huo Ming
穿成囚禁男主的反派要如何活命
To Be or Not to Be
悪役として生き残る方法
description:
Yuan Xiao already died once, and now he’s about to do it again. He's been transported from his life as a domineering CEO with a taste for internet novels to the realm of his favorite story. Yuan wakes up as the villainous ruler of the Northern Empire, and he knows exactly who’s going to kill him, the male lead Heqing Yan! This brave prince has already vowed deadly revenge after being conquered. Yuan knows he must change the story’s plot to survive, but damn, did the hero always look that good?


(Source: Tapas)

title: Major in Meanness
titleRomaji: Ben Xu Xiu de Shi Jian Dao
synonyms: Does Your Mother Need Son In Low
description:
In my previous life, I was forced to cultivate for a hundred years by a ruthless empress. I severed my soul just to escape from that tiger's den! In this life, I'll learn all the martial arts and soul techniques so that I can change this perilous world!


(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title: Sweet Bite Marks
synonyms: รอยกัดหวานละมุน
description:
A noble vampire prince falls for a menial human blood servant... from refusal to acceptance, she begins to worry about him and solve problems for him... However, there are gaps of status, classes and hatred between them, in this confrontation between vampires and humans, will they finally break the rule and be together? 



(Source: Webcomics)



Note: Includes 5 prologues, 7 extra, and 11 side story chapters

title: The Enchanting Villainess
synonyms: The Evil Sorceress Plans to Survive
description:
Ophelia's destined to be the antagonist of the story, persecuted for her wicked ways and lack of magical powers… until she gets a second chance. Aware of her fate, she makes amends for her notorious reputation and gathers allies, including the heroine, who's also her half-sister. How will her destiny change once these former rivals become best friends and she saves the lives of her father and steadfast bodyguard? If a visit from a strange spirit is an indicator, things are no longer by the book! 



(Source: Tapas)



Note: This is a new, rebooted version of a previously cancelled manhua.

title: Dreamland Adventure
description:
Howard, the lowly office employee, is stuck at the bottom of the corporate ladder until a chance encounter with the mimic dream system changes his life! Now he can access all the adventure he ever wanted: having adventures, fighting monsters and living with his gorgeous but fierce boss! The mission, as always, is to be attractive but independent, bold but sensitive.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Bromance
description:
In Clear Waters High School, the cheerful and humorous Justin used to be good friends with diligent Class President Ian. However, because of an unexpected note, they became gay partners in other's eyes. In their wonderful, yet unordinary 18 years old, will their "friendship" be able to take another step further?



(Source: WebComics)



Note: Although official sites haven't uploaded any new chapters since 2017, the author continued to release chapters on their Weibo.

title: My Feelings Can Wait
description:
Even as acclaimed actress Jing Xiu's wedding was going on, Weibo was flooded with news about the rising star Ji Youyan's death from alcohol poisoning. Then, another piece of news hit the headlines: Jing Xiu's wedding had been called off due to unforeseen circumstances. When Ji Youyan woke up, she found herself transported back in time. Three years ago, to be exact — two years after her breakup with Jing Xiu. This time, she swears she'll never lose Jing Xiu again...



(Source: Bilibili Comics, edited)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Blood and Steel
description:
The story begins with an eradication of Qingcheng by a group of martial art fanatic from Wudong, whose master and disciples only has one belief – to become the strongest. In order to maintain the supremacy, it takes over all the other martial arts group and kill those refuse to yield themselves to it.


Yan Heng, a young swordman in Qingcheng, was saved by ‘Wudang Hunter' Jing Lie, who also lost his fellows because of Wudong. Being the only remnant of their groups, the two allied and start their journey of revenge.

title: Zhege Tiandao Bu Hunyong
synonyms: The Heavenly Path Is Not Stupid
This Heavenly Law Is No Muddlehead
description:
The injustices of heaven and earth will be… pah, just because the previous incarnation of Tiandao was a bad guy doesn't mean I have to bear his faults! Even if we are both called Tiandao, we can do things differently. All this terrible fighting and killing! Watch as I re-balance the yin and yang, repair the wheel of reincarnation, and create an ideal world of immortal cultivation… as I take girls into my har… Never mind that, just watch and learn! 



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

relations.title: Pi Chai Shi Nian, Nüxian Gui Di Qiu Wo Shou Ta Wei Tu

title: From Simp to Billionaire: The Rise of a Divine Tycoon
titleRomaji: Bu Dang Tiangou Hou, Wo Cheng Le Yiwan Shen Hao
titleNative: 不当舔狗后，我成了亿万神豪
synonyms: After Improperly Licking a Dog, I Became a Billionaire
Me tornei bilionário após sofrer uma decepção amorosa
description:
Lin Xinben was just your ordinary simp. After getting dumped, he received the Shenhao System, which gave him billions to spend right away! But the painful part is that he must spend that money on girls! Oh well, in order to put the money use, Lin Xin will embark on a strange journey of revenge, by becoming a godly playboy!



(Source: Tencent Comics, translated)

title: I Am Invincible: Start From Awing My Empress Wife
titleRomaji: Kaiju Zhen Jing Nüdi Laopo, Wo Wu Di Le
titleNative: 开局震惊女帝老婆，我无敌了
synonyms: Invincible After Shocking My Empress Wife
Shocking The Empress Regnant, I Am Invincible
description:
When Ning Tian opens his eyes in the Celestial World, he’s stunned to find himself in the Queen’s private bedchamber! Once dismissed as a useless good-for-nothing, he’s now set to marry the peerless Queen Luo Wuqing tonight! Just as everyone’s jaws hit the floor, a mysterious system appears and tells him, “Shock others to earn rewards!” From astonishing the Queen to shaking the entire world, Ning Tian begins an unstoppable rise that will leave everyone trembling!



(Source: WebComics)

title: Sacred Ancestor
description:
Welcome to a new world of immortal cultivation, based on Fengshen Yanyi. There is Emperor Zhou. Other main characters like Jiang Ziya, Su Daji, and Yang Jian all have new roles. There are the three kings of Huoyun Cave and the three sages of Daomen. The beasts and villains are here, too, Chi You and Xing Tian. Into this world comes the boy Luo Lie, who will rewrite Fengshen Yanyi by not becoming a hero, but by becoming invincible!


(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Fanpai Shizun De Wo Dai Zhe Tudi Men Tian Xia Wu Di
titleRomaji: Fanpai Shizun De Wo Dai Zhe Tudi Men Tian Xia Wu Di
titleNative: 反派师尊的我带着徒弟们天下无敌
synonyms: I, The Invincible Villain Master With My Apprentices
description:
Shen Shi was very disappointed when he transmigrated into the book he wrote and didn't even end up as the protagonist. He also didn’t understand why the invincible hero became a girl? Even worse, why did all his apprentices want to become his wife instead! The protagonist asked him, “Master! Would you like to take me right now? Or do I have to kill off the other apprentices first before you'll have me?”



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Immortals' Wechat Group
titleRomaji: Wo De Weixin Lian San Jie
synonyms: My WeChat Links The Three Realms!
My Amazing WeChat Is Connected to the Three Realms
Wechat Của Tôi Liên Kết Tam Giới
แอปโซเชียลของผมเชื่อมต่อกับสามโลก
description:
Lin Hai used to be an ordinary college student, until he was added into a WeChat group where immortals made deals. From then on, his life has totally changed. The Queen Mother ran out of her facial masks? Ten peaches of immortality in exchange, no bargain. Daode Tianzun wanted some cigarettes? Ten Elixir Pills, no credit. The Red Boy craved for a bottle of Wahaha, a Chinese drink? Come on, give me your Samadhi Fire! Chang’e would like to wear sexy lingerie? Oh my, it’s a tricky case. I need to take her measurement in person. Yama wanted to buy a new sports car? Wait, was I associated with the underworld now? Well, bring me the Book of Life and Death, and check my name off...



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Quan Qiu Bing Feng: Wo Da Zao Le Mori Anquanwu
titleRomaji: Quan Qiu Bing Feng: Wo Da Zao Le Mori Anquanwu
titleNative: 全球冰封: 我打造了末日安全屋
synonyms: Global Freeze: I Created an Apocalypse Shelter
Freezing the World: I Built a Doomsday Safehouse
description:
The world is plunged into an ice age, and 95% of humanity have been wiped out! Despite his kindness, Zhang Yi was betrayed and killed by the very people he helped.



But Zhang Yi is reborn with an awesome power – space manipulation! Given a second chance, he starts hoarding supplies like mad to prepare for the icy apocalypse. This time, he'll be ready to rule the frozen wasteland! He vows to bring vengeance on those who betrayed him in the past life!



(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

title: Mirrorfield: Overturning the World with a Reversal Skill
titleRomaji: Chongsheng Hou Wo Yong Jingmian Fan Zhuan Fuchou
titleNative: 重生后我用镜面反转复仇
synonyms: After Rebirth, I Used Mirror Reversal For Vengeance
