Rebirth : My Vengeance Through the Mirror
description:
Fifty years after the fusion of the Game World and Reality, a top-tier warrior emerged. He dedicated his life to the world but was ultimately killed by the highest authority out of fear. Before his death, he awakened the SSS-Rank hidden skill [Mirror World] and sealed his soul beneath the surface of a lake. The King covered up the history and fabricated a new one; from then on, the warrior was known to the world as a traitor. Decades later, the warrior has awakened in the body of a dying man, using the [Mirror World] skill to begin his revenge.

(Source: WebComics)

title: Wo de Dizi Dou Chao Shen
titleRomaji: Wo de Dizi Dou Chao Shen
description:
Ye Yang, the game tester of the game company, crossed with the account of “full profession and maxed skill-set”! The life of a patriarch of man level sword master + immortal cultivator + magician starts. The headache is that a group of beautiful disciples advise him to improve every day.


(Source: Koudai Yuzhou, translated)

title: Lala
description:
Xia Yuxun's presence at school never fails to draw attention. She has a mature beauty about her, always poised, and exuding confidence in class. Being admired so much by her classmates, one would think she's a well-respected senior but in truth, it might be because she's a repeat student. Xia Yuxun has more to her elegant facade.



(Source: Webcomics)

title: I Have Twin Girlfriends
synonyms: I live at home with my twin girlfriends
My wife's twin sister lives at my home
description:
My girlfriend just dropped a bombshell on me: She has a twin sister that I never heard of... I've been kept in the dark all this time!



(Source: Wecomics)

title: CEO's Sudden Proposal
titleRomaji: He Shao De Shanhun Nuan Qi
synonyms: Cô Vợ Ấm Áp Của Hạ Thiếu
Der CEO und ich: Eine unerwartete Heirat
Hạ Tiên Sinh Lưu Luyến Không Quên
La esposa del matrimonio de shao
Mr He's Love Is Not Forgotten
ÉPOUSER UN PDG : Un mariage inattendu
กลเม็ดพิชิตใจคุณหมอ
ขอแต่งงานกะทันหันของคุณเหอ
description:
To become He Qiaoyan's woman, you must fulfill these three conditions: to like being pampered, to like being loved, and to like being taken good care of. You have fulfilled all the requirements, and all that's left is for you to be aware that you belong to me!



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

watchLinks.url: https://mangatoon.mobi/th/ขอแต่งงานกะทันหันของคุณเหอ?content_id=1721727

title: I Ship My Rival x Me
synonyms: I Ship My Adversary X Me
Wo Ke le Duijia x Wo de CP
エゴサしたらライバル×俺の二次創作にハマりました
description:
Wei Yanzi and Gu Yiliang burst onto the acting scene together, igniting a rivalry fueled by their shared debut. But while Gu Yiliang dazzles with his acting prowess and idol-worthy looks, Wei Yanzi finds himself in the shadow with only his striking appearance to boast. Amid the barrage of online hate from Gu Yiliang’s fervent admirers, Wei Yanzi’s patience wears thin.



When Wei Yanzi stumbles upon an online community totally convinced there’s a romantic entanglement between the two actors, he is initially shocked but soon finds solace in their speculation as he immerses himself in their discussions.



Though their relationship is purely professional, Wei Yanzi can’t shake the growing sense that maybe the shippers are onto something. As he spends more time with Gu Yiliang, lines blur, and Wei Yanzi begins to wonder if there might, after all, be truth behind the fan-fueled fantasies!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)


Note: Chapter count includes 7 extra chapters.

title: My Lucky Star
description:
The cute and bubbly Star Mu has been childhood friends with popular and athletic Austin Si since they were five. The pair know each other like the back of their hands, but as they hit their teen years, they’re beginning to think of holding hands…! Despite their close and sweet bond, these fresh feelings can’t help but spark issues. Star begins to pull away, and the usually perceptive Austin finds himself at a loss. With new friends on the horizon with their own goals in sight, perhaps things are no longer so clear and simple as they once were… 



(Source: Tapas)


Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title: The King and Me
synonyms: Till We Meet Again, My King
description:
When Zhang Li left for a trip to the Ebiz ruins, he didn’t expect to bring back company, especially not a man made of stone! Though Li grows fond of the living statue, their time together doesn’t last long, as “Rocky” soon crumbles before Li’s eyes. Wishing for a miracle, Li suddenly finds himself in Ebiz far back in the past and reunites with Rocky. However, his companion is no longer a statue but rather the nation’s king, who doesn’t recognize Li at all and imprisons him! How will Li escape this predicament and get his beloved back?



(Source: Tappytoon)

title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
description: The village boy Han Li was born poor. To subsidize household expenses, he joins the Qixuanmen Sect. Because of his spiritual roots, he was accepted as a disciple by the mysterious Doctor Mo and started to practice "Changchun Gong" arts under his mentorship. Although his qualifications are mediocre, Han Li embarked on the dangerous road of immortal cultivation with his unyielding will and a mysterious vial picked up by accident.

relations.title: A Record Of Mortal's Journey To Immortality
A Record Of A Mortal's Journey To Immortality—Immortal World Arc
Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan: Yanjiabao Pu Zhan
Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan: Modao Zhengfeng
Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan: Fanren Feng Qi Tian Nan Chongzhi Ban

title: When A Necromancer Maxes Strength
titleRomaji: Liliang Dian Man? Wo Ke Shi Wangling Fashi A!
titleNative: 力量点满？我可是亡灵法师啊！
synonyms: Power Point Full? I Am A Necromancer
description:
Elliott wakes up in another dimension and becomes a necromancer with zero Wisdom—but one ridiculous advantage: raw physical power. Unlike ordinary necromancers, he can't summon a single undead. So he fights the only way he knows how: with his fists. And when even dungeon bosses can't survive one punch, who needs an undead army?



(Source: WebComics)

title: Doomsday: Virus Monarch
titleRomaji: Quan Min Mo Ri: Wo, Bingdu Jun Wang
synonyms: Doomsday for All: Me, Virus Monarch
description:
When the apocalypse descends, the world transforms into a brutal game of evolution—humanity’s final trial, and the favorite playground of gods and demons. Brian Carter time-travels back to ten days before it all begins. Armed with foreknowledge and no time to waste, he injects himself with the zombie virus and awakens a legendary SSS ability: Virus Monarch! Now, with the power to command infection itself, Brian forges a terrifying new path through the chaos, one where he doesn’t just survive the end of the world, but rules it!



(Source: WebComics)

title: Shuangjing
description:
In the Republic of China, famous Shanghainese author Xu Youyi has everything anyone could want—until the day an anonymous letter arrives, revealing the truth behind her perfect life. Betrayed by both her best friend and her husband, she meets Yan Wei, the outwardly cold but inwardly warm owner of a photography studio. They click instantly, both independent yet in harmony with one another. Growing closer in the turbulent dangers that surround them, the two different women soothe the scars within each other's heart. Will they be able to save each other?



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)



Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title: Xi Xing Ji
description:
The journey to the West was a conspiracy of heaven! After Sutra went missing for more than a decade, Heaven sent its army to search, in order not to let the Sutra once again fall into the hands of heaven, the journey to West begin again.



(Source: White Cloud Pavilion)



Note: Includes two extras chapters.

relations.title: Xi Xing Ji: Qiong Qi Didong
Xi Xing Ji: Anying Mo Cheng

title: Peerless Refiner
description: She is the greatest and the last cultivator of the twenty-fourth century; however, due to a certain mishap, she crossed into another world, into another body which has families oppressing her, a scumbag fiance abusing and stepping over her... Trying to take advantage of her now? Keke! Knocking on death's door! Those who follow her will prosper, and those that oppose shall die! Behold as she pays back those who attempts to climb over her several folds!

title: The Mighty Warrior From A Mental Hospital
titleRomaji: Cong Jingshen Bingyuan Zou Chu De Qiangzhe
titleNative: 从精神病院走出的强者
synonyms: The Strong Man From the Mental Hospital
description:
In a world being invaded by evil creatures, they are no match for the patients at this insane asylum. Even the strongest beasts are stripped of their dignity, reduced to ingredients and pets. Welcome to the Qingshan Asylum, filled with the strongest and most dangerous patients. Lin Fan, considered seriously ill because he claimed to control the system, insisted that he was definitely not insane. He is just a normal person who is trying to cultivate himself by poking the electrical socket, climbing on high-voltage transformers, and standing on the rooftop during a thunderstorm dancing with a metal pole.



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Mojito
description:
Cool and quirky runway model Simone and her witty lawyer lover Marissa were spotted KISSING on the street! Not only that, the photo is all over the internet and people will NOT stop talking about it!! Now their families, employers, and even the public are pressuring them to call it quits on their relationship. But despite their struggle to gain acceptance, Simone and Marissa are set on showing everyone that love is like a well-mixed drink; the sweeter the taste, the harder it is to put down.

(Source: Tapas)

title: The Prince's First Love
description:
The flawless Prince Nazaire changes schools in hopes of wooing a bride… only to encounter the tyrant Cassius Li! At first, the two cannot stand one another, as they constantly infuriate each other. Yet between ball dances, rescues, and secret rendezvous, Nazaire and Cassius begin seeing each other for who they truly are. But love between a prince and a commoner could never happen, and if Nazaire hopes to ascend the throne, he will have to give up Cassius. Torn between love and duty, can the prince and tyrant reach their happily ever after?



(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title: Kaiju Qian Dao Huanggu Shengti
synonyms: Scoring the Sacred Body of the Ancients from the Get-go
Start by signing in and obtaining the Ancient Divine Body
description:
Jun Xiaoyao transmigrated into a fantastical world and into the body of the scion of a prominent clan, which will give him powerful backers and incredible talent. He is also given the Login System, which provided him with a fully-formed ancient sacred body right from the start. With the help of his System, he will march to the pinnacle of this world!



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Zhang Zhong Zhi Wu
description: A beautiful and successful lady tries to reclaim her life after she gets caught in a twisted game of revenge by a wicked and cruel man.

title: Paraselene
description:
After emerging from an accidental journey to the Boss World with a new set of skills, I have been hiding among the other players of Phantom Moon, searching for the secrets concealed within this game. In order to achieve my goals and find my missing brother, I’ll have to bend – and sometimes break – the very rules of this virtual reality in my favor. Guilds? Other Players? Powerful Bosses? All are simply stepping stones on my way to a destiny greater than the game’s mysterious designers could ever have imagined.



(Source: WebComics)

title: The Silent Concubine
synonyms: 愛も憎しみも沈黙の中で
description:
The Prince Commander of the North wants the daughter of the Shen family as his concubine. In order to give his adoptive mother a better life in her old age, the family's mute servant, Shen Yu, conceals his gender and takes the daughter’s place. But Shen Yu is afraid that once his identity is revealed, he’ll be executed. To his bewilderment and relief, he only attracts the attention of the Prince even more... but is that really a good thing?



(Source: Comikey)

title: Return of the Master
synonyms: Trọng Sinh Khí Thiếu Quy Lai
description:
Brandon, an unwanted son of a wealthy family, was saved by a demi-god after being murdered. The demi-god taught him the secret of cultivating. Unfortunately, three hundred years later, he lost his life again during a failed heavenly tribulation! This time, he was sent back to where he started, the unwanted son again! Will he repeat his tragic fate this time?



I'm no longer the bullied boy now. Try me if you dare!



(Source: MangaToon)

title: Goddess of Jealousy
description: The innocent starlet Xiao Fengyu got the chance to work with the cold-faced superstar He Yunhan in a variety show as mentor and trainee. It seems like a great chance for Fengyu to get in with the goddess, but how come it feels like she's always running into trouble with her?

title: The Doomsday Ruthless Man: Hoarding Trillions of Supplies at the Beginning
titleRomaji: Mo Ri Hen Ren: Kai Ju Tun Ji Wanyi Wuzi
titleNative: 末日狠人：开局囤积万亿物资
description:
After being reborn back to the time before the apocalypse, Su Chenren has become a man of few words. Having already experienced the downfall of doomsday and betrayal by his fiancee, he understand the importance of preparation. With his powers of teleportation and spatial manipulation, he will gather up all the materials needed to survive the apocalypse. This time will be different, he'll be ready for anything!



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Battle Frenzy
description:
A sky with two moons; a soul world of endless possibilities;

Lonely darkness, and a strange and mysterious clown!

A federation of 100 cities. Three great empires. A world where monsters run rampant.

This is an age where heroes are born, where humanity strives to retake the earth!

And at the epicenter of it all: a special second-year student, Wang Zhong, who uses the power of the Playful Roulette to shake the whole world! You hear that, ladies? Your Senior is here!


(Source: WebNovels)

title: Returning from the Immortal World
synonyms: Return of the World of the Celestials
description:
The Great Emperor Xingxiu in the Immortal World, whose name on the earth was Tang Xiu, died in a disaster. After his death, part of his soul comes back to his body on the earth. To his surprise, ten thousand years in the Immortal World is only equivalent to one year on the earth.

(Source: WebNovel)

title: Global Beast Tamer: I Can See Evolution Paths
titleRomaji: Quanqiu Yu Shou: Wo Neng Kanjian Jìnhua Luxian
titleNative: 全球御兽：我能看见进化路线
synonyms: Global Beast Tamer: I Can See the Path of Evolution
Beast Taming: I Can See the Evolution Paths
description:
After transmigrating into a new world, I end up with a tiny Snowball as my Pet Beast. Everyone laughs, calling it the weakest of the weak—an evolution dead end. A nobody with a useless companion… is that really my fate? Ding! The system activates. I can now see the hidden evolution paths of all Pet Beasts. Weak, you say? Watch closely how my little Snowball is about to evolve and awaken as the Ice Queen.



(Source: WebComics)

title: Bei Xiaohua Fenshou Hou, Wo Zhijie Wudao Tong Shen
titleRomaji: Bei Xiaohua Fenshou Hou, Wo Zhijie Wudao Tong Shen
titleNative: 被校花分手后，我直接武道通神
synonyms: Dumped by My Girlfriend, I Turned to Martial Arts
description:
Fang Yi, transmigrated to this world, has just been dumped by his beautiful schoolmate girlfriend. He initially thought this would be the start of a modern romance, but then the system alerts him that a spiritual energy resurgence will begin in one year, leading to drastic changes in the world and the apocalypse.


“With a system, what the hell am I afraid of?”

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

title: Moving Gold From A Post-Apocalyptic World
titleRomaji: Wo Zai Mo Shi Ban Jin Zhuan
synonyms: I Am Carrying Gold From the Post-Apocalyptic World
description:
Is the road to riches paved with wearing? No, Wang Bin has a better way to get rich, by entering the post-apocalyptic world, collecting gold, going back to his world, and easily becoming a billionaire! That being said, going to the post-apocalyptic world to collect gold is not an easy task, there are countless zombies, aka "wanderers", and the survivors there are more terrifying than the wanderers! In the fight for survival, these survivors are a hundred times more dangerous than wanderers!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Doctor Du Ming
description:
Du Ming, young anesthesiologist in a big Chinese hospital, is haunted by the memory of Zhang Qian: a young lady coming from the same school as him , who bewitched him by the sulphurous beauty and the aura of strangeness she emits. 

After graduating, Du Ming stayed in touch with Zhang Qian, who writes him. Now a terrible piece of news arises: the young lady is said to have committed suicide.

title: My God Tier Leveling System
synonyms: 神級レベルアップシステム
description:
In the year 2666 of the Earth Era, the world is overrun by monsters, laying waste to human homes. Amid the chaos, a meek warrior with unbreakable spirits and unwavering resolve embarks on a quest to rewrite his destiny and ascend to the rank of the most revered warrior of his time.



(Source: Tapas)

authors.name: Ke Lan Ji Yuan Cong Jiang

title: C.A.T.
description: The third World War is nearing. Each super power country is going through a communications war to prepare for it, a war to obtain the top profiles' information of enemy countries using the Russian's secret weapon BEAR, China's Hao Long, and the United State's Confidential Assasination Troop, a.k.a. CAT.

title: Wo Shi Wo Qi
description:
Qiu Yi is a salaryman in his 20s. After going to the wedding of his highschool crush, he becomes disillusioned as he thinks about the past. However, a sudden shocking event sends him back in time 10 years! ... as a girl named Ye Wen!? Qiu Yi faces another strange twist—his former self still exists!



【Am I still myself? Who exactly am I?】 What kind of sparks might ignite when he, as a girl, meets his male self?

title: Hun Dun Jian Shen
description:
After his death, Jian Chen’s soul was reincarnated into a foreign world. He grew up with swift speed, but at the end, because of overflowing enemies and from being heavily injured, his soul abnormally changed at the border of life and death. From then on, he stepped onto a completely different path of sword cultivation and became the Sword God of the generation.



(Source: Flower Bridge Too)

title: Yueguo Chenshi de Ge
synonyms: The Song That Transcends This World
description:
During troubled times, Weng Shaoying is one of the most famous singers in Dongping. Many people go to Song of Fairyland just to see her perform. However, under her glamorous facade, she has been controlled for more than 10 years. On the other side of Dongping is Bi Xing Tang, one of the most famous gangs there. After her father’s death, Yanchu became the young female leader of Bi Xing Tang, which caused a lot of rumors to spread. On one inevitably fortuitous night, the two happened to meet. At that time, neither of them knew that they would eventually become the most important person in the other’s life. Starting from that night onwards, the gears in Shaoying and Yanchu’s fate will forever be rotating together.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Xian Ni
description:
Saints, the most formidable beings under the heaven. Follow Tie Zhu as he entered one of the elite sects: Heng Yue Sect and work his way toward to become a saint.

(Source: OSTNT)

title: Almighty Master
synonyms: The Peak Master of the City
description: Let’s take a look at our young hero here, who was born and entered the world of Martial Arts. There’s nothing that he cannot do! Be it music, chess, medicine or even culinary arts. Pretending to be the weakest while he is the strongest. Women from left to right, look at how an orphan rise. An orphan who will solve numerous cases and who will become the master of the city!

title: Extraordinary Son-In-Law
description:
On their wedding day, he was thrown out by his wife and forced to return to his own home, where he was suddenly ambushed by a glamorous woman searching for a kiss. The moment their lips touched, he felt a torrent of energy surge through his body. When he woke up again, his mind was filled with the memories of thousands of strangers...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Kiss the Abyss
description:
As a rookie game designer, Wang Zixin never imagined that he'd get sent to hell and back by the game's male protagonist. And the only way to escape this death cycle is by crossing into the game and raising Abyss, the game's male protagonist, healthily. Wang Zixin: "Not only do I have to go through this survival game, but I have to raise a child while doing so??? This isn't even humanly possible..."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Apocalyptic Super System
synonyms: ゴッドシステム～終末の救世主～
description: The end of the world is coming, terror covers the whole world, and the earth becomes a hunting ground for zombies and mutants. Zhao Tianlei accidentally obtained a mysterious super system. Although he is not a saint, but seeing the tragic situation in the world and the death of his classmates, how can he stand by and look at how Zhao Tianlei, who has a super upgrade and exchange system, leads humans Fight against corpses, restore human civilization?

title: Healing Hands, Miraculous Doctor
description:
The Super Doctor From 2089 Comics Online. A brilliant doctor from 2089 somehow time-travels back to the year 2019, along with all his badassness. Want a healthy body? Go to the Doctor! Want unmatched beauty? Go to the Doctor! Want to survive the ambush by a bunch of mercs? Still, go to the Doctor. This Doctor is capable in every aspect...well, almost every aspect, except when it comes to his romantic encounter with girls.



(Source: MangaToon)

title: Zai Bu Si Wo Jiu Zhen Wu Di Le
titleRomaji: Zai Bu Si Wo Jiu Zhen Wu Di Le
synonyms: If I Die, I will Be Invincible
If I Don’t Die Soon, I’ll Really Become Invincible!
description:
Transmigrating into a world of immortal cultivation, Ye Qing gained the ultimate cheat! He will gain invincibility the moment he dies without suicide! So he tried like crazy to court death!


But then the Empress of Zhou proclaimed, "I met my soul mate in Ye Qing. If he dies, I will die with him!"

An immortal from the heaven realm: "The mortal world is a cruel place, only Master Ye always treated me kindly. I will protect him with my life!"

The common people: No one will be missed in this world, but only Master Ye is irreplaceable. He is a true saint!

Ye Qing: "At this rate I'll become invincible even without dying…"



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Forty Millenniums of Cultivation
description:
"Even if this universe is truly nothing more than a brutal, bloody, dark forest, we Cultivators will burn all that we have just to give off a single weak flickering spark in the darkness!"



"No matter how weak each spark is, how short-lived, how small... As long as the sparks flow unabated, then one day one of those sparks will light some tinder, and that tinder shall light some fallen branches, and those branches shall set ablaze each and every last tree of the forest!"



"In the end, even the smallest sparks will eventually set the dark forest ablaze and illuminate the whole world!"

title: The Lady and the Lion
description:
When she was young, the vivacious Princess of the Western Kingdom met Latio, a Prince from the Saga Kingdom. As their hearts grew closer, the young king of the Eastern Kingdom, Nia, secretly watched from a distance... Unfortunately, the peace enjoyed between the three kingdoms was not to last, and war was imminent. Childhood friends would eventually be faced with having to choose between their love and their duty. Swords and blood, smoke and tears, loyalty and betrayal all interweave together, forming the song of these young people in the Empire of Theodor.



(Source: Pocket Comics)



Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

title: Chasing The Sun
description: High school student Xiao Xiang An is experiencing life in the big city for the first time while she is staying with her distant relatives. At the behest of her relative's friends, she ends up disguising herself and sneaking into a bar with them where she runs into a handsome and charming employee. The following day she goes back to her regular appearance only to have a very different encounter, meeting a guy who is nothing but rude and hateful!

title: Heaven's List: Saint's Era
description:
The youngster, Jiang Yinian, became acquaintances with Mu Chen, Lin Dong, and Xiao Yan's descendants on the Spirit Road's Trial, and also stole someone's heart, too. In the process of the trials he realized that he had connections to the Fiend Clan that had been sealed in the Prison Realm, and so, the story begins...



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

relations.title: Dou Po Cangqiong: Yao Lao Chuanqi
Cang Wan Bang Zhi Wan Shou Gui Yuan

title: Social Temperature
description:
Song Yuan Xun is a homophobe with a cold personality. He matched with Fang Zhao Mu on a dating app, but he absolutely detests him. He discovers that Fang Zhao Mu is more clingy than he thought!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: The God Devourer
description:
Bei Ming lost his right arm and leg in a car accident, and ever since people harass him for that.
One night he gets attacked by gangsters, but as he's about to die he gets monstrous strength. 



(Source: INKR)



Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Shiguang Dailiren
description:
In a certain corner of the city, there is a seemingly ordinary little shop — Shiguang Photo Studio. The shop's proprietors Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang can enter a photograph and explore its original  time and space. One day, Lin Kai, a rising star in the traditional opera scene, came to the studio and asked Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang to find a person in a picture from 10 years ago. There is only one photograph, and there will be only one chance…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: The Cultivator From The Future
synonyms: This Monk Comes From The Future
This Cultivator Came From The Future
description:
Tang Ming, one of the top cultivators, was defeated by aliens and reborn back into his high school years. He decided to stage a great come back and protect the world. No woman can resist him. The previous life's goddess, talented maiden, sexy teacher, domineering lady and alien princess are all in his harem. No power dares to against him. The thirteen clans, religious groups and secluded mighty cultivators all have to bid him their allegiance. This time, he plays a decisive role in achieveing the properity of cultivation across the world. 



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Final Will
description:
Jinniao Star is under siege. Only those who have a powerful guardian spirit, a "War God", can change their fates and stand against enemies. Rogge is a teen boy; his father had the strongest War God, but betrayed the country, causing Rogge and his mother to be bullied and the loss of their home. To regain the fame and change destiny for his family, this teen boy entered the world's fiercest and scariest place, the Villain Academy, to fight against opponents with powerful War Gods. Can Rogge fight his way out and and become the strongest in this world? What's the truth behind his father's betrayal? Come find out in Final Will.



(Source: MangaToon)

title: I Am the Invincible Genius
titleRomaji: Wo Shi Wu Di Da Tiancai
synonyms: 俺が無敵の大天才になるまで
description:
On the brink of death following a harrowing accident, a college student is granted another chance at life. And this time around, he'll be assisted by the mysterious Prodigy System- an ethereal sentient that awards points and offers abilities that make everything from athletics to exams a breeze.



(Source: Webcomics)

title: The Divine Doctor
synonyms: The Divine Doctor: Daughter of the First Wife
Doctor Divino: Hija De La Primera Esposa
description:
With a clap of thunder, Feng Yuheng, a god at both Western and traditional Chinese medicine, transmigrates to the time of the Shun Dynasty, into the body of an abused teenaged girl. You wish to kill me? A single stab of my scalpel will paralyze half your body! My pharmacy from the past life is always with me, and fame and fortune rest within the palm of my hand. Even the Emperor wishes to be my acquantance! And you, you roguish prince... are you toying with me?



(Source: Webnovel)

title: The Eternal King
description:
Framed to death in his previous life, he is reborn to his high school and happens to witness the resuscitation of fairy and the radical change of the world. Being young again, he restarts cultivation. This time, he'll protect his friends and family, he'll leave no regret, and he'll be the eternal king! 



(Source: Webcomics)

title: The Deathless
description:
An ordinary girl as she is, she possesses the eyes of death which can make her see the death rate of others. Even if she's troubled, she has no access to death! Hearing her calling, the god of death comes for her. However, it’s useless? What will happen between a girl who desires death and the god of death who cannot kill the girl? What’s the secret of the girl's superpower... 



(Source: Webcomics)



Note: 92 mainline chapters + 12 extras chapters, not counting character intro and merchandising announcements.

title: Touch Your World
description:
Xie Cheng, who was born unable to see any color, had been living in a black and white world for many years. Until the day he met Bai Lu, who was being chased, he accidentally discovered that he had brilliant colors. What kind of sparks would be created between two very different people together?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: My Disciples Are All Hot Badasses
synonyms: My Apprentices Are All Female Devils
description:
When he woke from his slumber, the Night King found himself resurrected! It has been 300 years, his disciples that he trained through efforts have now attained immortality and grown up, each beautiful and elegant! “300 years… 300 years! It is my turn to tease…No, guide you all!”



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Fell in Love with Girlfriend's Brother
titleRomaji: Wo Ai Shang Le Nü You De Di Di
synonyms: I Fell In Love With My Girlfriend's Brother
Kanojo no Otouto ni Koi Shite
I Fell In Love With Girlfriend's Brother
Fell in Love with GF's Brother
description:
To prove whether he was a homosexual, Qiu Zinan decided to dress like a woman and go to a bar. There he “was seduced to the bedroom” by a handsome stranger. Feeling reluctant on the bed, Zinan revealed his true identity, but all they could hear later were the hard breath of one another, and that was how the game began!!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Trapped for Millions of Years: My Disciples Are All Over the Universe
titleRomaji: Bei Kun Bai Wan Nian: Dizi Bianbu Zhu Tian Wan Jie
titleNative: 被困百万年：弟子遍布诸天万界
synonyms: Imprisoned One Million Years: My Disciples Are All Over The World
Imprisoned a Million Years: My Disciples Are All Over the World
Ten Thousand Year Stranded: Disciples Covering the Whole Vast Universe
Trapped for Millions of Years: Followers All Over the World
百万年の眠りから覚めた
description:
Lu Chen, an immortal young man, was trapped in the Land of Desolation for over ten million years. After thousands of centuries of meticulous planning, he finally managed to escape... only to find a world vastly different from the one he remembered. The Old Continent had broken into countless pieces, the North and South Poles had been reversed, and the nine suns in the sky had been reduced to a single one; the oceans had sunk dozens of meters deep, huge and powerful prehistoric beasts had all but disappeared, and humans, who millions of years ago were only a small nation of tribesmen, had by now conquered the surface of the Earth. And that's not all: the mangy dog he had picked up by chance is now the leader of a sect, the little girl he had adopted out of kindness has become a fairy of a heavenly realm, and his disciple, whom he had been forced to take in, has become the Celestial Emperor.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Zui Wu Dao
description:
In a world of martial arts, a young boy namned Wu was unable to practice martial arts due to his special body, will he accept his fate and live his life bullied and looked down by others or will he rise and become a master?



(Source: OSTNT)

title: Find Me in the Dark
description:
When a young Ran Tang thwarted a kidnapping attempt on her friend, it left her blind and shunned by her family. A chance encounter brings Zhan Luo into her life and their surprising connections (including being engaged to her horrible sister!) keep pulling them back together. She wants nothing to do with this bad boy and yet the usually cold and standoffish Zhan can’t help but be drawn to her. He’ll basically do anything, yes, ANYTHING, to stay in her life! But how can he get closer to her if he constantly keeps her in the dark?



(Source: Tapas, edited)



Note: 

- Includes prologue, Christmas special, and eight epilogue chapters.

- Tapas and INKR have different titles and translations. Tappytoon uses the INKR version.

title: Bing Jiao Meimei Zhi Xiang Rang Wo Qifu Ta
titleRomaji: Bing Jiao Meimei Zhi Xiang Rang Wo Qifu Ta
titleNative: 病娇妹妹只想让我欺负她
synonyms: Mi hermanita solo quiere que la intimide
The Yandere Sister Just Wants Me to Bully Her
description:
Gu Xing, a novelist, deeply detests manipulative women who play coy, so she intentionally created such a main character for her webnovel, so she can abuse the fictional character in all sorts of ways! However, she never imagined that she would end up transported into her own story, and now she gets to take it out on her personally!

But due to her own fetish for pretty girls, she couldn't bring herself to harm the beautiful protagonist she created, and she eventually ends up becoming her protector instead… As she was worrying about her own mixed feelings, the supposedly helpless protagonist pushes the male lead away and insistently confesses her love for Gu Xing instead! What! So I was the one being protected all along!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Shen Sheng
description:
Shen Sheng was taught to be nice and obedient, he was gentle and tolerant, people called him "Moral Model". One day, he found a secret, and because of the secret, his peaceful life drifted away, he got braver, he released himself from the rules and started to make decisions for himself.


(Source: Pocket Comics)


Note: The chapter count includes 5 special chapters.

title: Super Villain System
description:
Who is he? Why is he called the Boss? Maybe he’s the fearless ruler of the world. Or maybe the worst enemy of humanity, who tears worlds down. After Su Sin was reborn, he lost all his skills and abilities from former life in a knights’ world. However, a newly implanted System can help him restore them. “My name is Su Sin where Sin means Promise keeper”.


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice: Season 1
synonyms: The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice
description: Nian Bing is the son of a fire mage and an ice mage. After both of his parents were killed by the Ice Lord, Nian Bing received both of his parents' magic gems. When Nian Bing was trying to escape from the Ice Lord's followers, he managed to cast both fire and ice magic at the same time. An impossible feat for a mage. He fell from the cliff, unconscious, and was saved by an oldman. After he woke up, the oldman gave him a food so delicious he never tasted before. It turned out that the oldman was a genius chef, once called a spirit chef. And he wants Nian Bing to be his disciple no matter what! Is Nian Bing able to seek vengeance while aiming to become the greatest chef?

relations.title: The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice
Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
Soul Land - The Legendary Gods' Realm
Soul Land - The Legendary Tangs' Hero
The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice: Season 2

title: The First Greatest Eternal God
description:
Even in his dreams, Li Tianming can’t stop himself from laughing! Why? Because his family pets are all the Primordial Chaos Beasts of myth!

That teeny weeny little chick over there is actually the eternal Infernal Phoenix that eats suns! His black cat is the Genesis Chaos Thunderfiend that refines worlds with its lightning. 

The cockroach, well, it’s the Myriad Worlds Deathless Beast that possesses trillions of undying clones…

Followed by his menagerie of pets, Li Tianming begins his ascension to become the number one beastmaster of the ages. He journeys across the many worlds, only one thing remaining constant. No one is ever ready for the likes of his pets! After all, who's ever prepared to fight a chicken and its fellows.



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Gaishi Dizun
description:
A young slacker was insultingly called the 'sleeping god' suddenly unlocked an outlandish martial arts technique by accident. From then on, he became an invincible prodigy who could crush everything in heaven and earth, and pierce the stars with his sword, as all the prodigies tremble at his feet.



(Source: MKZhan, translated)

title: Swallowed Star
description:
In the Year 2056, a teenager clad in a tactical vest, combat pants, and alloyed combat boots sat atop a ruined and shattered six story apartment building. The building lies in a Prefecture-level city in the Original Jiangsu area. With a Hexagonal Shield and a Bloodshadow Combat Sword on his back, the young man sat silently on the edge of the roof. Under the brilliant hue from a starry night, it brought forth a breath of fresh air as the night breeze caressed his body. However, within this now ruined city, all was silent... all except for the occasional chill-inducing howls...



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Alluring Hunk in Women Wonderland
titleRomaji: Zheli De Meizi Dou Xiang Gonglüe Wo?!
titleNative: 这里的妹子都想攻略我?!
synonyms: I Eat Soft Rice in Another World
異世界の女子達は俺に夢中！？
description:
After witnessing a once-in-a-century blood moon event, Zhang Hao loses consciousness and awakens to a world turned upside down. Gender norms and beliefs have been completely reversed, where women are now expected to pay dowries and propose to men. Women have taken on the role of breadwinners, while men are expected to be stay-at-home husbands. In this society, women without cars or houses face social stigma and struggle to find partners. It has become the norm for women to pursue men, while men making the first move on women is considered taboo. "I won't depend on women to support me! I will reclaim my true masculinity as a real man!" Follow Zhang Hao's journey as he navigates an inverted world filled with enticing challenges and temptations, all while striving to hold onto his identity as a man.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: Fatal Possession
synonyms: マイ レッド スパイダーリリー
description: Shen Fan is determined to understand the inner world of the one she has secretly admired for three years. Her desperation draws her like a moth to a flame, even as she knows that her love may kill her. And what does the latter think? "This girl is very interesting, I suppose I could play with her a little."

title: Lost In Reverie
synonyms: 白昼夢の果てに君を見る
description:
Eugenie Lin, a high school student, unexpectedly crosses paths with the infamous Juan Shen at his tattoo parlor. Little does she know, fate has a plan. As the new school year begins, they find themselves seated side-by-side, revealing a softer side to Juan beneath his tough exterior.



(Source: WebComics)

title: Emperor Is Back
description:
Over the years, countless powerful cultivators have come and gone. 
But the world never realized that behind every powerful cultivator, there seemed to be a mysterious... Dark Crow. After the Dark Crow guided a legion of young cultivators to the peak of cultivation and established their own sects, he chose to leave the world behind.



Thousands of years have passed since his departure, and the once mighty sects have become weak and in danger of failing. Finally the Dark Crow returned in the form of a young man, here to fulfill his promise to defend the sects.



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Aikugui, Qing Cang Ni de Yanlei
titleRomaji: Aikugui, Qing Cang Ni de Yanlei
titleNative: 爱哭鬼, 请藏起你的眼泪
description: The life of two "normal" high school girls? Su Mu wants to overcome her anxiety to confess to Lin Dai Xue, on the other side Dai Xue keeps making opportunities for Su Mu to confess. Both of them know each other well but neither of them is willing to be truthful to the other.

relations.title: Jintian Yiding Yao Dui (Rang) Ni Gaobai

title: Dragon Tamer
description:
The cultivation prodigy Zhu Minglang expended all his power to save his companion dragon. Now just a poor, powerless boy, he somehow managed to have a one-night stand with the lady general Li Yunzi. Then his enemies came flying in on fire-breathing dragons, willing to burn down the entire city just to hunt him down while he was weak. Zhu Minglang managed to escape death and became a dragon tamer, looking to start a new legendary journey.



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Fake Slackers
description:
When the classroom rosters were announced, the school's two most notorious boys Xie Yu and He Chao were not just placed in the same class, but became desk-mates as well. Even though they're obviously smart, they pretend to be delinquents, always acting out, fighting to be last in class rank. They may look like they're playing games and slacking off every day, but they actually study hard in private. So what's the deal with these two guys who are always at the bottom of the class on every test?



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: The Mythical Realm
description:
A world of blood, a world where the strong triumph over the weak, Ye Yun descended to hell to slay hordes of Demons and ascend to Heaven to slay the Gods just to prove his existence as the strongest, a world where a single being can rule over Heaven and Earth.



(Source: Web Comics)

title: You Xun Ran Shi Youxi Fei Zenmeban
titleRomaji: You Xun Ran Shi Youxi Fei Zenmeban
titleNative: 幼驯染是游戏废怎么办
description: The daily lives of a gamer and her girlfriend.

title: Lord System
titleRomaji: Wo Shi Yishijie Zui Qiang Lingzhu
synonyms: I am the Strongest Lord in another world
description:
To become the ultimate game character, you must meet three conditions: gain access to the game's "Lord System" control panel, take over the body of a noble family's illegitimate son, and make sure nobody else knows they're in a game. Well, Richard Orlando fulfills them all! Now he must build an army and fight through goblins, gnolls, trolls, and more to discover new lands, all while keeping the Lord System a secret. But with that trump card on his side, it'll only be a matter of time before he conquers all and becomes the ultimate Lord of the new realm!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: I Dominate a Magical Continent with an Industrial Revolution
titleRomaji: Wo Zai Mofa Dalu Jian Li Gongye Diguo
titleNative: 我在魔法大陆建立工业帝国
synonyms: Forging an Industrial Empire in a Magical World
Forjando um Império Industrial em um Mundo Mágico
Building an Industrial Empire in a Magical Land
Je vais industrialiser ce monde magique
description:
After meeting an untimely death due to overwork, Larsen Jin reawakens as Ren Edgar, a spoiled young master, on the magical continent of Eldoria. Gifted with a special game system and a territory to rule over, the new Ren will do what he can to start an industrial revolution and bring an end to the continent’s era of corruption!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Spiritpact
description:
A young and broke man, Yang Jinghua, finds himself 10 years younger after waking up from a traffic accident. Just as he is dreaming about it being a rebirth after death and that he will soon reach the peak of his life, a handsome white-haired man who calls himself the “Spirit Cleanser” appears in front of him. After this man tells Yang Jinghua “You are already dead”, he proposes a weird offer: “Boy, do you want to make a pact with me?” Gradually, a deep relationship is developed between these two men and they support each other on their journey.



(Source: Webnovel)

relations.title: Ling Qi Zhi Yue Luo Shanhe

title: My Nine Female Apprentices
synonyms: 元教祖様と9人の女弟子
description: You're flexing in front of me? Watch me humiliate you! Women? I have nine of them! I am matchless! Yeah, that's how arrogant I am!

title: Gu Shi Yu Ni: 300 Tian
synonyms: The Story About You x Me
The Story About You and Me
description: The school’s famous troublemaker—— Gu Ze! Originally only on 30-day class duty, student union vice president Ye Ruchuan ‘changed it a little’, making it 300 days... Two people fighting a battle of wits for whether to be on class duty or not! As the shocked bad guys go their separate ways, Gu Ze and Ye Ruchuan gradually start to get to know each other in the middle of a hateful godlike manipulation, and slowly cultivate an understanding of each other..... delinquent vs. vice president! The daily life of a 17-year-old trying his best to skip class duty!

title: Metropolitan Supremacy
description:
In the aftermath of a car accident, Yang Ning has inexplicably gotten a set of abilities. He seems to have entered a game-like system. In the real world, there are attributes and tasks, warehouses and shops, and the ability to identify and view information on antiques. He used this ability to get into the antiques market and gain dominance in it.



What else will he do? Oh, pretty girl, come and buy my wares! I promise i won't cheat you! Maybe? Shut up, system! Don't you dare cheat me too!

title: Kuang Shen
description: A world where humans, beasts, demons, gods, dragons and pixies fight for supremacy; A war where great beast warriors of the Baemon troop, the dragon knights that soar in the sky, and the demon race that befell into the angel troops battle. A mixed blood child, who bears the blood of a human, demon and beast, went through hardships that no other people had, and has unmatched wild war potential. He is destined to restructure the chess pieces of this world, and also fated to have an exceptional heart-wrenching love life.

relations.title: Soul Land 3: Legend of the Dragon King
Soul Land - The Legendary Tangs' Hero

title: Supreme Ocular Master: The Peerless Heiress
titleNative: 至尊瞳术师：绝世大小姐
description:
Luo Qingtong, a young lady from the 24th century who ranked first among those with superpowers, miraculously transmigrated into a different world. There, she begins her journey of vengeance as the crippled, oldest daughter of a duke from the lower kingdoms, where villains line up to get face-slapped and scumbags and manipulative bitches wait to get tortured!



An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. She'll exterminate anyone who offends her! All is going well... but then she accidentally gets involved with a man of peerless beauty, whom she attempts to flirt with whenever she's unable to win against him in a fight. From there on, it becomes a story about their romantic pursuits..."



(Source: WeComics)

title: I Might Be A Fake Cultivator
titleRomaji: Wo Xiu Di Keneng Shi Jiaxian
synonyms: I Might Be a Fake Cultivator
description: It's a cultivation story. One with immortal gods and cultivation arts. But more importantly, it's the story of a boy named An Lin, a mortal who was heavily in debt and was pursued by loan sharks before meeting his savior, a True God. Saved from the loan sharks, An Lin was sent to cultivate at the Immortal Cultivation United University, but it seems like he was trolled by the True God...? Is this really the life he was expecting? Wasn't this just a regular cultivation story? What's that? I might be a fake cultivator?

relations.title: War God System! I'm Counting On You!

title: Tale of Old Snake Cultivation
synonyms: The Immortal Art of Becoming a Dragon
The Tale of a Snake's Cultivation to Immortality
Snake Immortal: The Tale of a Snake's Cultivation to Immortality
description:
In a quiet mountain village, an old serpent accidentally swallowed a mysterious cultivator's elixir—and in that moment, its mind awakened. From then on, it embarked on a perilous and exhilarating journey toward immortality. In just ten short years, it defied the ravages of time, racing against fate itself. It hunted demons, vanquished evil spirits, and carved its path against the will of heaven. This is the legendary tale of a serpent's ascension—from the dust of the mortal world to the boundless skies beyond. A saga of transformation, courage, and defiance begins.



(Source: WebComics)

title: I'm Not the Overlord!
synonyms: I Am Not the Demon Lord
description:
I actually reincarnated into a different world and became the Demon King Overlord?! And my task is to destroy humanity! Wait, that ain't right. I'm a pacifist you know? I'm not like this at all? What? I killed a thousand human army with my energy blast?! That was an accident! It was the relic's fault! It's all a misunderstanding! Hahaha! Why can't we get along nicely? Huh? So what if I'm the devil? Doesn't mean I like doing bad things! Stop annoying me or I will blast you to kingdom come! Wait! Argh! Come on! I'm not that evil! I'm not the Overlord!



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Phoenix Goes against the World
synonyms: 穿越之绝色兽妃：凤逆天下（凤逆苍穹）
description:
When she opens her eyes, Huang Beiyue, a talented killer known as “ultimate weapon”, finds that she travels through time into another world and possesses a girl’s body, who is the trueborn daughter of princess royal but humiliated by everyone. With such an identity, Huang Beiyue rises from obscurity. Meanwhile, a mysterious guy becomes more and more interested in her…



(Source: MangaToon)

title: Kai Ju Qiang Wen Liekounü
synonyms: Awakening SSS-Rank Skill After A Kiss
description:
The story starts with a deep kiss with a demon-woman, which awakened his SSS-level skill. What's going on here? Scheming loli, cool genius, innocent schoolgirl, and seductive demon as girlfriends... Faced with wave after wave of bad omens and misfortune, Lin Que feels like he's under a lot of pressure, when all he wants to do is to quietly farm monsters and level up until he's the strongest!



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Lich: Glory Knight
titleRomaji: Mai Xiang Ke Li Ma Sha
synonyms: Adventures of an Undead Who Became Paladin
Onward To Cremisha: The Lich Paladin
description:
"Humility! Honesty! Compassion! Bravery! Justice! Sacrifice! Pride! Faith!" 

He’s a lich, yet he abides by the chivalric code of knights! 

He’s a lich, yet he holds fast to faith and light! 



"Be fearless no matter how formidable the enemy! Be bold, loyal, and never disappoint the Holy Spirit! Be faithful, upright, and never submit to evil! Protect the weak, and never violate the heavens!" 



He stands unfettered at the top of the world, no matter how many curveballs life throws at him. No one—not even the Holy Spirit—could stop him from following the Holy Spirit! 
This is a story about a lich who becomes a knight and saves the princess.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: I'm Just An Invincible Immortal
description: In this era, people are always reincarnation, but I Lin Fei, depends on being immortal. I have lived for hundreds of million years, just to find my beloved ones that I lost for a million years!!

title: Yu Qiang Ze Qiang, Wo De Xiu Wei Wu Shang Xian
titleRomaji: Yu Qiang Ze Qiang, Wo De Xiu Wei Wu Shang Xian
titleNative: 遇强则强，我的修为无上限
synonyms: Strength Through Adversity, My Cultivation Knows No Limits
As I Become Stronger When I Meet a Strong Opponent, My Cultivation Has No Upper Limit
description:
Ye Lingjun, on the verge of death, awakened the Strength Through Adversity System, which marked the start of his unlimited cultivation ascension. Immortals, saints, and Taoist masters? They all better stand aside! To build a following, he picked up a few disciples. The eldest disciple was once the leader of the demonic sect. He may seem vicious and rebellious, but he soon becomes tamed. The second disciple is a white-haired loli, blessed with the perfect saintly constitution. She could become the strongest of them all, but she loves to cook, and she'd rather serve her master a fancy meal instead!



(Source: Tencent, translated)

authors.name: Yong Le Jie Wen Hua Yi Fan Xing
Shi Shang Zui Shuai Zuo Zhe

title: I Picked Up An Attribute
titleRomaji: Wo Jian Qile Yi Di Shuxing
description:
Feng Xia, a completely hardworking game player, travels through time and space. With his power, attributes, and strategies learned from the games he played before, he can beat his enemies and get their Light Masses of Attributes. Besides, he also meets all kinds of beauties along his way... His enemies laugh: "My martial arts are invincible!" Feng Xia just beats them and absorbs their Light Masses. "Indeed. But sorry, it's my martial arts now!"


(Source: WeComics)

relations.title: Shuxing Fanwai Zhi Wo Jian Qi Le Yi Di Meizi
Wo Jian Qile Yi Di Shuxing

title: Jiulong Chengzhai
description: Everyone in his Triad gang looked up to him. He was the boss’s favorite pupil, but then in a single night, after he had won so many territorial fights for his gang, he lost everything! Why?

title: Billionaire Player
description: Acting pretentious is his hobby! Being the ultimate rich player, he’s used to spending “expenses” around others on the down-low, having the most extravagant equipment and armor. In the gaming world, there's nothing that can't be solved with money!

title: Winner Takes All
description: A young wealthy businessman was suddenly kidnapped by a dark organization that he refused to work with. He was used as an experimental subject of developing new chip-based technology that gives the subject extra-ordinary abilities. Will he be able to escape and take revenge?

title: Dou Po Cangqiong: Yao Lao Chuanqi
titleRomaji: Dou Po Cangqiong: Yao Lao Chuanqi
titleNative: 斗破苍穹前传之药老传奇
synonyms: Battle Through the Heavens Prequel - The Legend of Yao Lao
Dou Po Cang Qiong Prequel - The Legend of Yao Lao
Fights Break Sphere – The Legend of Yao Lao
Dou Po Cang Qiong Zhi: Yao Lao Chuanqi
薬老伝奇～錬丹術の帝王～
description:
This is the Dou Qi world, where the strong are respected and the weak are despised. The Yao clan is one of the eight ancient clans with a Dou Di’s blood in their veins, and it is a holy land for alchemists. Follow Yao Chen, Xiao Yan’s teacher, as he goes from his low position in the Yao clan to standing at the summit of the Dou Qi continent.



Located on the edge of the Dou Qi continent was the Yao clan descended from an ancient Dou Di. Not only was this place isolated from the Central Plains, it was also a breeding ground for poisonous insects and vicious beasts. But with the Yao clan’s incredible strength and their exquisite alchemy, it became a holy land that was worshiped by alchemists. Born in a weak branch family, orphaned by his father at a young age, treated with indifference by the clan, and banished from the clan for false charges when he tried to display his talent. He experienced all kinds of trials and adventures, in the end gaining the title of the Central Plain’s mainland number one alchemist. But because of his apprentice’s betrayal, not even his bones remained…



How did Yao Chen go from a youngster in a weak branch of the Yao clan manage to reverse his fate to become the mainland’s number one alchemist?

What kind of encounters did he have after being banished from the Yao clan?

From a lowly trash to the top of the mainland, just how many secrets are still hidden in Saint Yao’s story?
 

 
Note: Includes 12 extra chapters

title: Ten years later, I married my Nemesis
titleRomaji: Shi Nian Hou, He Siduitou Jiehun Le
titleNative: 十年后，和死对头结婚了
synonyms: Ten Years Later, I Married My Nemesis
Married to My Enemy After 10 Years
description:
After 18 years together, freshman Han Shen and childhood friend Su Qian have been admitted to the same university. After Han Shen got struck by lightning, he became confused. He claimed to be from ten years in the future, and that he and Su Qian were married! For the boy who claims to be a husband and the girl who isn't sure about her feelings, they find their relationship can't help but change…



(Source: Pocket Comics)

title: The Bizarre Adventure of Miss Capricious
titleRomaji: Xiang Chen Wei Feichai De Gongjue Xiaojie
titleNative: 想成为废柴的公爵小姐
synonyms: I Just Want to Be a Useless Duke's Daughter
The Duke's Daughter Wants to be Useless
To be a useless Duke's Daughter
description:
I was reborn into a novel "The Mistake of Cleavens" and became a silly, love-deprived young lady. Fame? Power? Love? Those are not enough to attract me, as I happened to be the richest girl in the world! Yes, I'm going to lead a brand new life with all the wealth I got. 

But wait! I seem to recall that the ending of this novel is a bad end?! The world collapsed because Lady Cleavens abandoned a cat, which brought the doom of the world! 

Alright, even if I need to adopt all the cats in this world, I'll do it as long as I can reverse my fate and save it from its doom!



(Source: MangaToon)

title: Genshin Impact 4-Panel Comics
description:
Official 4-koma comic for the award-winning game, Genshin Impact. No set schedule.


A relaxing trip in Teyvat >Note: Includes chapter 16.5, 16.6.

title: King of the Realms
description:
Three centuries ago, this man was a powerful emperor, but he ended up being assassinated by his own fiancée the night before their wedding. Three hundred years later, he somehow managed to defy fate and got reincarnated and thus began his journey to cultivate forbidden Supreme Arts and awaken his Divine Meridians! Now, he isn't going to let anyone get in his way.



(Source: WebComics)

title: Dang E Yi Yu Dao Bing Jiao
titleRomaji: Dang E Yi Yu Dao Bing Jiao
synonyms: When the Villainess Meets the Crazy Heroine
When the Villainess Meets the Yandere
description:
A yuri story about a yandere commoner × villainess lady. When the arrogant noblewoman He Sha tried to bully the commoner girl Qiao Lin out of jealousy, the yandere Qiao Lin turned the tables and took her first kiss instead. At first, He Sha just wanted to get back at Qiao Lin by playing pranks on her, but eventually it became an excuse to try to attract Qiao Lin's attention… The more the villainess tries to mess with the yandere, the more the yandere returns the favor, which only makes the villainess more tsundere.



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: The Martial Emperor's Life After Seclusion
synonyms: Life of a War Emperor After Retirement
description:
Ever since he transversed into the realm, he turned into an adorable, lovely, androgynous man, who is coveted by many. Fortunately, Ling Ge has a mysterious physique and his strength automatically grows. After touring around Eastern China and finally suppressing the western gods in a single battle, he has been called the Martial Emperor since then. Subsequently, the androgynous martial emperor has been living in seclusion. Nonetheless, he became friends with a young loli, and the androgynous Martial Emperor came out of seclusion again!



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: The Secret Tales of a 30-Year-Old Gay Bachelor
synonyms: The Story of a 30-Year-Old Gay Bachelor
description:
Wei Qiuyu is seen as a calm and reliable executive, but he is keeping his gay sexuality a secret. At the behest of his mother, he gets into a blind date with a woman, but meets Fu Yicheng instead. Though Qiuyu finds Yicheng an annoyance, he can't help but be drawn to him every time they meet.



(Source: INKR)



Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title: Shen Wei E Yi Nü Pei De Wo Yang Cheng Bingjiao Nüzhu Hen Zhengchang Ba?!
titleRomaji: Shen Wei E Yi Nü Pei De Wo Yang Cheng Bingjiao Nüzhu Hen Zhengchang Ba?!
titleNative: 身为恶役女配的我养成病娇女主很正常吧？!
synonyms: It Would Be Normal for a Supporting Villainess Like Me to Raise the Yandere Heroine, Right?!
As a Villainous Heroine, It's Normal for Me to Develop the Heroine to Be Yandere, Right?!
description:
Jiang Yang is a game artist out gathering material for the game she was working on when she fell off a cliff and transmigrated into a world of immortal cultivation. She diligently cultivated her way to immortality, and she was about to ascend and return to her own world when a mysterious glitch caused her to transmigrate again, this time into a world of magic (like the start of an otome game). She met the main heroine, who was being bullied by the villainess at the Magic Academy, and that was when Jiang Yang realized that this is the world of the game she was working on? Now her fate is tied to Xin Lu, the heroine of the game. Jiang Yang thought that if she just beat the game, she can finally return home. But as the story progressed, she remembered all the over-the-top plotlines made up by the lousy writers, and she can't stand seeing Xin Lu suffer through it anymore. So she steps in and helps Xin Lu reject the playboy prince, teaches her cultivation techniques to fight off the bullies, and even seduces Xin Lu herself! As they become more intimate with each other, Jiang Yang starts to realize that her fate might intertwine with Xin Lu more than she realized…



(Source: Bilibili, translated)


Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Super Teacher
titleRomaji: Xiu Xian Gui Lai Zai Xiao Yuan
description:
He used to be the most ruthless emperor in the immortal world, knocking down all his fellow immortals. He had tamed and ridden a Golden Dragon, turned a White Tiger into a cat, and made a phoenix into fried chicken. He had slept with the goddess of the Nine Heavens and stripped in the Heavenly Palace… Now he has returned to the urban life and become an ordinary teacher for chitchat. Girls, get your clothes on, I'm here to teach you some manners!



(Source: WeComics)

relations.title: Xiu Xian Gui Lai Zai Xiao Yuan Di Er Ji

title: Yi Shi Xie Jun
description: Jun Xie was the number one assassin in modern earth. His skills and knowledge in the field of assassination were unparalleled, his accomplishments unprecedented, his reputation terrified the entire underworld. However, during a mission to retrieve a mystical treasure, a mishap occurred… He is now Jun Moxie, a sixteen year old super level debauchee, sole heir to the declining Jun family. A family of valiant heroes, left with an old grandpa, a crippled uncle and a debauchee as the sole heir! Accepting the world’s criticism and cold stares with a smile, his new journey begins! His life will be carved by his own will! Rise to the top! Evil Monarch Jun Xie!

title: After Rebirth: Upgrading through Consumption
titleRomaji: Chongsheng Bu Dang Tianwang, Wo Duzi Kejin Shengji
titleNative: 重生不当舔王，我独自氪金升级
synonyms: I Regressed to Level up Instead of Being a Simp
description:
Han Liee, who didn't do well in the college entrance examination, got frustrated in love, and achieved nothing after graduation, prayed to God that if he could start over again...



With the advent of the consumption system, he actually went back to the year when he was 18! No superior skills? He could upgrade his skills with points! Too average in appearance? He could shape his face with points! After the time travel, he taught a rich guy who picked on him a lesson and captured the hearts of some popular pretty girls... Let's see how Han Liee would rise from the ashes and become a top-tier man after his rebirth.



(Source: Webnovel)

title: My Dragon System
titleRomaji: E Long Zhuan Sheng, Fu Chou Cong Wu Sui Kaishi!
titleNative: 恶龙转生，复仇从五岁开始！
synonyms: My Vampire System: A Dragon's Revenge
Evil Dragon Is Reincarnated! Revenge Begins at the Age of Five!
description:
I was originally the apex predator that stood at the top of the world—the legendary red dragon. For thousands of years, my countless brethren have been murdered by humans, and revenge slowly turned into my only reason for living!In the end, however, I failed. On the day of the final battle with the humans, I was slain, and died with vengeance burning in my heart...If there were another life, I would definitely avenge my kind!If there were another life, I would make those filthy humans pay for what they've done!If there were another life... Huh?I got reincarnated as a feeble human child?!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: The Daughter of Duke Doesn't Want to Be Spoiled
titleRomaji: Gongjue Xiaojie Bu Xiang Bei Chong Huai
synonyms: ダメ令嬢は甘やかされたくない
The Ducal Lady Doesn't to Be Pampered
description:
Yvette Winchworth is worshipped like a deity for her grace and beauty. Little do the people know, she's spoiled to the core and can hardly feed herself much less fight for the throne that's now up for grabs! Desperate to keep her away from conflict, her mother ships her away to a group of mercenaries who can keep her safe. Can this spoiled noble last amongst a group of cold-blooded soldiers?



(Source: Tapas)

title: Sweethearts in the Spotlight
synonyms: The Top Couple Is a Bit Sweet
description:
Song Yan and Wen Li are a well-known contract couple in the entertainment industry. Even though they are married, they don't make a big deal out of it and they each do their own thing professionally. Most people are pessimistic about their marriage, yet many fans ship them together, too. The two of them finally started acting like a loving pair in public, but only reluctantly, when they officially announced their participation in a nationally televised reality show about married couples. But as they spend time together in front of the camera, the two of them gradually realized that the bonds of their marriage had already been firmly tied long before.....



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: The Butcher of All Realms
titleRomaji: Yi Ba Shazhudao, Kan Fan Wan Jie Hen He Li Ba?
titleNative: 一把杀猪刀，砍翻万界很合理吧？
synonyms: A Pig-Slaughtering Knife That Cuts Through All Realms — Makes Sense, Right?
In My Eyes, Everyone's a Pig — and I'm a God-Tier Butcher
description:
On class assignment day, Craig Yates gets stuck with the best version of the worst job: Divine-class Butcher. He's immediately written off as useless by everyone—even his childhood friend—but even a worthless job like Butcher comes with perks: extra damage to pigs, half damage from pigs. But Craig also has a secret—he can only see living things as pigs. Thus begins the ascent of a worthless Butcher...



(Source: Tapas)

title: The Last Tomb Keeper
description:
Lu Shuiyin was a poor high school student who also happened to be a game guru. One day, he turned out to be the heir to a legacy worth 500 million, but the legacy was merely game coins. While still in his puzzled state, a girl he loved was kidnapped, and a series of mysterious events took place afterwards. In the end, he found himself dragged into a game of "tomb robbers", and his mission was to engage in a long-lasting battle as "the last tomb keeper".

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Back to the Mortal World
description: Bai Li Yun Xiao - with a spiritual life in the continent Jiuxiao. After his death he was resurrected, however, he returned 300 years ago, returned to urban adolescence, changed his life, and climbed to the top of the world again. "Whether in heaven or on earth, only I can win"

title: My Wife is Daji
synonyms: My Wife Is a Fox Spirit
description:
What does this pretty girl want with me? To marry me? That won't do... What about this pretty lady? You wanna marry me too? Tsk tsk, since when did I become so in demand?



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: All Hail My Adorable Master
description:
In order to save the world, I'm forced to accept the male MC as my disciple! But why is he so different from when I met him in our previous lives? He's so innocent and shy now, like a little puppy. Well, since you're so loyal and obedient, I'll take you in as my disciple! Wait... You traitor! Stop pouncing on me!



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Dijun Shizai Tai Qiangshou
synonyms: Rebirth of the Emperor in the Reverse World
description:
I was once the lord of the cultivators in the immortal realm. But I was reborn into a world where the women worked to earn a living, while the men sat around and looked pretty. Even worse, my body looked like a fat slob! I worked hard to get into shape, but I didn't do it for the benefit of you thirsty women!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: No. 1 Grandmaster in History
description:
When Lin Feng was transmigrated into another world, he was gifted with a power system, but he also faced a mountain of pressure. Because the system gave him the main mission to start a new martial arts sect, and build it up to become the most powerful master in the world! Lin Feng got started right away. Hey kid, come join my sect!



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: The Guy Inside Me
description:
At Linzhen High, Sheng Xu is the resident bad boy, while Zhan Shao is the by-the-book school genius. They’re polar opposites and butt heads every chance they get! But one day, their worlds get turned upside down when they mysteriously switch bodies. While navigating life trapped in an unfamiliar body and learning to work as a team to maintain their respective tough-guy image and perfect GPA, they discover hidden truths and deeper feelings for each other. But can opposites attract when the guy you like is... you?



(Source: Tapas)



Note: Includes two bonus chapters and two epilogue chapters.

title: National School Prince Is A Girl
synonyms: The School Prince is a Girl
帝少心头宠：国民校草是女生
description:
Fu Jiu appears to be a normal lad in high school on the surface. But in fact, she (Yes! She!) is the hacker, Z, a villain-terminator in the online world of an alternate world. Having reincarnated into the body of a woman and being forced to disguise herself as a young man, she reigns over the game world, fights for justice, and puts a spell on all the girls around with her innate charm. However, her flirting comes across as gay to the rich Almighty Qin and his inner circle. Over time, the Almighty Qin falls for him… her. Has he turned gay for him… her? Now, that's confusing!


(Source: Webnovel)

title: Meet Me After School
description:
Yu Le took the blame for someone else's mistakes due to a favor that he had to repay, deeply offending the most handsome guy in school, Gu Yan. He's been on Gu Yan's radar ever since he started school. Gu Yan stops Yu Le after school and bothers him every day in order to take "revenge" on him. He originally wanted to teach Yu Le a lesson, but as time passes, "revenge" turns into something else. Gu Yan begins to take a liking to Yu Le and finds it harder and harder to hurt him...



(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Bringing The National Husband Home
titleRomaji: Guomin Laogong Dai Huijia: Tou Wen 55 Ci
titleNative: 国民老公带回家：偷吻55次
synonyms: Taking the Perfect Husband Home: With 55 Stolen Kisses
Bringing Home the Dream Husband: 55 Stolen Kisses
description:
"Don't touch me when we're out in public."

"Don't openly say that I am your wife."

"Don't let people know that you and I live together."



Lu Jinnian and An Hao were forced to marry as a result of their parents' arrangements. An Hao thought their marriage would be loveless and inescapable, so she gave Lu Jinnian three don'ts on their wedding night.
Lu Jinnian looked at her, expressionless, and blinked his eyes. Can't touch her in public? He'll do it in secret. He can't say that she's his wife? He'll say that he's her husband. And as for the final don't... In an interview, he declared to the entire world: "Every night, I share a bed with An Hao."



(Source: Webnovels)

title: The Outcast
description:
The grave of Zhang Chunan's long-dead grandfather was desecrated by a group of mysterious people, but his grandfather's corpse wasn't the only thing they dug up. Secrets and mysteries surrounding the Zhang family began to surface, and Zhang Chunan is apparently more than just an ordinary college student desperate to be rid of his virginity.



One day, Zhang Chulan is attacked by zombies in a graveyard. In the midst of that situation, he saves the life of a girl, throwing the kitchen knife in his hand in order to kill the enemies. The girl tells Chulan, who is relieved, to face his hardships head on and leaves. However, Chulan later sees that girl again at his university. From that moment, Zhang Chulan's destiny begins to move. There will be strangers with special powers appearing one by one, with battles involving those abilities. Each episode will bring a new mystery to light.



First published under the title 异人 (Yi Ren, literally: "Weirdo") and with subtitle King of the Weirdo in February 2015. A collaboration Chinese/Japanese anime television series adaptation titled Hitori no Shita the outcast (一人之下 the outcast) aired in 2016.

relations.title: Yi Ren Zhi Xia: Tianshi Xia Shan
Yi Ren Zhi Xia Fanwai: Xiutie

title: I Stayed At Home For A Century, When I Emerged I Was Invincible
titleRomaji: Wo Zhai Le Bai Nian Chumen Yi Wudi
titleNative: 我宅了百年出门已无敌
synonyms: Invincible After a Hundred Years of Seclusion
在宅至上主義 ～俺だけのチートシステムで天下無双した件～
description:
Chu Xuan travels through time and becomes a young master of a powerful family in a fantasy world. Because of a small mistake, he is banished from the ancestral house and driven to a remote cottage. However, he does not care because he has access to a system that makes him stronger as he spends more time at home. After having been home for a day, he is rewarded with the Indestructible Body Technique. After having been home for a year, he is rewarded with the Jade Void Sutra and a century of cultivation accomplishment. Nobody can make him go out. He will stay here for good!

(Source: Webnovel)

title: Take A Good Look at Me Now
synonyms: The First Son-In-Law Vanguard of All Time
description:
Xu Wuzhou opened his eyes to find himself transmigrated into the body of a notoriously delinquent son-in-law. The guy spent his wedding night in a bridesmaid's bed, and wandered into a brothel in search of a meal. Now his beautiful wife has lost all faith in him, and his father-in-law exiled him to the training grounds in disgust. And all Xu Wuzhou got for this trouble was an ancient artifact starving for blood?



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: The Superb Captain in the City
description:
When Li Yifei retired from active duty, all he wanted to do was to live a quiet life surrounded by beautiful women. But there's always bad guys coming around looking for a beating. As the former top man in the special forces, he'll gladly oblige them. So much for a quiet life, but at least he has the beautiful women by his side!



(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Your Scent is a Little Sweet
titleRomaji: Ni De Weidao You Dian Tian
synonyms: Your Taste Is a Little Sweet
description:
Due to past psychological trauma, Tang Chao never developed secondary sexual characteristics, so she lived life as a beta working as a magazine model. After an accidental one-night stand with an omega, she found out that she felt strongly attracted to that omega. The next day she met a new colleague Li Zhixu, who seemed to be that omega. But... this Li Zhixu was suppose to be a beta?



(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Psychic Princess
description:
Yunxi Qian, the oldest daughter of the prime minister was born with a special ability. Because of this she was deemed 'abnormal' and was raised at Mt. Lin Yun.

Upon turning 16, she took her younger sister's place to marry into the royal family of Ye.

Rumors say Youming Ye is strange, cold and cruel. Just how will Yunxi Qian's fate play out?

title: Losing Money to Be a Tycoon
titleRomaji: Kui Cheng Shoufu Cong Youxi Kaishi
synonyms: Losing Money to Become the Richest Person Starts From the Game
description: Finding himself back in time 10 years ago, though technically an almost parallel world in 2009, Pei Qian got a system where he gets money to run his business. The funds for business and personal use are separated. After a set period, he can earn his personal funds according to how much his business funds he has left. The catch? Pei Qian earns more when he makes a loss in his business funds. Happily thinking how easy it would be, with many failed start-ups proving a point, Pei Qian founded his company Tengda and achieved financial freedom through the losses. Unfortunately, fate has other plans for him.

title: Ta De Shan, Ta De Hai
titleRomaji: Ta De Shan, Ta De Hai
description:
Chi Tang and You Yu are both shunned outcasts in Year 1 Class 2 of high school. They are desk-mates, roommates, and each other's salvation, keeping each other warm. Their relationship gradually grow, from just a feeling into something unforgettable, an epic story of young love.



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Going Rogue in the Apocalypse
description:
A cosmic storm brought about a wave of mutations for all sorts of species. Giant, poisonous zombie monsters roamed the cities and roared as they waved battle-axes. Exotic beasts fought for territorial supremacy in the jungles. Humans were also awakened to a new ability known as the Cosmic Power... Zhou Zheng transmigrated into this post-apocalyptic world without any Cosmic Power. But he will take advantage of the powers offered by the rogue class in this game system to destroy the darkness and pursue ultimate power!



(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title: Reborn to be a Supreme Emperor
synonyms: クエストクリアで万界を制覇する
description:
The son of the supreme being, Qin Shu, is a Son of God, but he was born with a mortal body and mortal fragility. Being despised by everyone in the Heavenly Path, his identity is even about to be taken away and himself demoted to the mortal world, until he activates the Myriad Realm Registration System!



(Source: Webcomics)

title: Supreme Yanluo System
description:
On a fateful and accidental night, Xue Wuxuan was selected out of the millions by the Yanluo system, to be coined as the new King of Hell, also known as Yanluo.



Join him as dives into the mysterious unknown and crosses thousands of planes and realms to become the strongest Yanluo in the universe.



(Source: Webnovels)

title: Full-Time Sword Cultivator
description:
In an era where reality and a game had become one, Lin Jichen, the greatest mage in Eternia, was stabbed in the back and killed by the people he trusted the most—his lover and the man he considered his brother. Yet destiny had other plans for him. He regressed to the day before Eternia’s launch and gave up the staff for a sword! Join him on a journey to rewrite the future with the blade of a sword!



(Source: WebComics)

title: Wo Zai Xiuxian Shijie Chao Jiu Wan Wu
titleRomaji: Wo Zai Xiuxian Shijie Chao Jiu Wan Wu
titleNative: 我在修仙世界朝九晚五
synonyms: I Work Nine to Five in the Immortal Cultivation World
I Live From Nine to Five in the World of Cultivating Immortals
description:
Hua Qingyuan, dies suddenly due to overworking on a ‘996’ schedule. However, he finds himself transported to a fantasy world to become the top disciple of the Qingyun Sword Sect. Determined not to repeat the mistakes of his past life, he resolves to work no more than eight hours a day and not waste even a minute on extra cultivation. He becomes an anomaly in the sect, relaxing under a tree, enjoying his life after work, even as other disciples practiced day and night. Nevertheless, his unmatched talent in swordsmanship still makes him a formidable presence.
